memories.memory_text: She told me she wasn't scared, that it was nerve degeneration, and after I saw her scarf and thin hair, she said I wasn't the only one with a death sentence.

memories.memory_text: I signed the form to donate my body to Project Angel, finalizing my consent.

memories.memory_text: After I signed, she took the clipboard, touched my hand, and thanked me, saying she was sorry.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport is being escorted by guards down the death row corridor, indicating the beginning of his execution process.
memories.memory_text: I felt the cold clank of my chains with every step as the guards led me down the corridor, past other Micah Hollis who watched in silence or gave quiet nods.

grounded_facts: The Evan Colter uses his authority to urge Rowan Davenport to confess before execution, appealing to moral or spiritual closure.
memories.memory_text: The Evan Colter told me it was my last chance to confess, urging me to speak up before it was too late.

grounded_facts: The formal process of carrying out Rowan Davenport's execution, including escorting him and offering a final chance to confess.
memories.memory_text: I realized this was the final process—being moved by guards, hearing the Evan Colter’s plea, and being given one last chance to speak—everything pointed to the end.

grounded_facts: The Evan Colter attempts to elicit remorse or a final statement from Rowan Davenport regarding the victim's family.

memories.memory_text: I felt the needle go into my forearm and saw the deadly IV running into my arm as they started the lethal injection process.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport expresses remorse for his past actions and for the world's suffering as he faces death.
memories.memory_text: I expressed that I was sorry for being angry and stupid when I was young, and I apologized for everything, for the whole damn world.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport emerges from the mud, naked and disoriented, after an unknown period of dormancy, beginning to regain consciousness as rain washes the mud from his face.
memories.memory_text: I emerged from the mud, naked and disoriented, slowly regaining consciousness as rain washed the mud from my face, and when I finally saw the sky, I screamed.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport discovers a destroyed city in the distance after traversing a desolate plateau.
memories.memory_text: I reached the edge of a rise and saw a decimated city in the distance, buildings collapsed into rubble, after trudging across a desolate plateau.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport discovers a pack of cigarettes and a butane lighter in the shirt pocket of a human skeleton behind a collapsed newsstand.
memories.memory_text: I found a pack of cigarettes and a butane lighter in the shirt pocket of a skeleton behind a collapsed newsstand.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport lights a cigarette and inhales, expecting a rush, but feels nothing and becomes disappointed.
memories.memory_text: I lit one of the cigarettes and inhaled, expecting a rush, but I felt nothing and became disappointed.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport replaces his rags with cleaner clothes found in a ruined store, improving his appearance and possibly comfort or protection.
memories.memory_text: I pulled on jeans and sneakers, finally getting rid of those rags that were falling apart.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport uncovers and inspects an army jacket from under fallen ceiling tiles, indicating potential interest in acquiring it.
memories.memory_text: I kicked aside some fallen ceiling tiles and found a rack of army jackets, then picked one up to look it over—it looked good.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport discovers a dusty bottle of whisky while searching through rubble behind the bar.
memories.memory_text: I was searching through the rubble behind the bar, using my lighter to see, and I found a dusty bottle of whisky.

grounded_facts: After drinking the whisky, Rowan Davenport chokes, becomes instantly dizzy, and passes out on the floor.
memories.memory_text: I took a drink from the whisky bottle, toasted a skeleton nearby, and immediately I choked and became dizzy—I passed out on the floor.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport tears the poster of a smiling woman from the bus kiosk, folds it, and stores it in his pocket, preserving it as a symbolic substitute for Avery Keaton.
memories.memory_text: I tore the woman's face from the broken poster, folded it carefully, and kept it in my pocket because her smile reminded me of Avery Keaton.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport realizes the approaching Nico Delaney are not human but Casey Nolan Terminators with red-flickering eyes, prompting him to flee.
memories.memory_text: I froze when I saw the Nico Delaney ahead—my heart stopped realizing they weren't human; I saw their red-flickering eyes and knew they were Casey Nolan Terminators, so I turned and ran in fear.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport disarms the boy by grabbing his gun hand, firing into the air, and taking him hostage to demand information.
Rowan Davenport grabs the boy and demands to know where he is, using physical force.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed the boy's gun hand, forced it up to fire into the air, and took control of his weapon while holding him tight, demanding to know where I was.

grounded_facts: The girl points a shotgun at Rowan Davenport and demands he release the boy.
memories.memory_text: I saw the girl pointing a shotgun at my head and heard her shout 'Let him go!' like she was ready to shoot me.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport uses the oil lantern to knock the girl down, retrieves the shotgun, and gains full control of both weapons.
memories.memory_text: I used the oil lantern to knock the girl down, sent the boy flying into her, and snatched up the shotgun before they could recover.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport discovers that both the handgun and shotgun are unloaded, revealing the kids' bluff.
memories.memory_text: I checked both guns after taking them and realized neither the handgun nor the shotgun had any rounds in them, so I figured the kids were bluffing.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan pulls Rowan Davenport to cover just in time to avoid detection by a passing Hunter-Killer vehicle.
memories.memory_text: I was looking toward the light, unaware of the danger, when Nico Nolan suddenly grabbed my arm and shouted, 'Get down, they've seen the light!'—then he pulled me back behind the debris just in time to avoid being spotted by the Hunter-Killer.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan tells Rowan Davenport his name and explains that he calls the girl 'Jonah Bellamy' because she doesn't remember her own name.
memories.memory_text: I was told my name is Nico Nolan, and he explained that he calls the girl 'Jonah Bellamy' because she doesn't remember her own name.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan suggests Rowan Davenport can come with them to find shelter.
memories.memory_text: I remember Nico Nolan telling me I could come with them if I wanted, suggesting we go find shelter together.

grounded_facts: Jonah Bellamy hisses at Nico Nolan, questioning why they should bring Rowan Davenport along.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jonah Bellamy hiss at Nico Nolan, questioning why they should bring me along, making me feel unwelcome.

grounded_facts: After hesitation, Rowan Davenport chooses to follow Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy toward shelter as dawn approaches.
memories.memory_text: After looking around at the desolate world and seeing the two teens moving ahead, I chose to follow them toward shelter as dawn approached.

grounded_facts: A tense confrontation and exchange between Rowan Davenport and two teenage survivors at a highway off-ramp.
memories.memory_text: I approached two teenagers at the off-ramp, and the boy questioned me while holding a handgun and a lantern; he searched me and found scraps of paper, while the girl kept a shotgun aimed at my head—I shoved the boy into her when she threatened me, and later he pulled me to safety behind cover when danger passed, so I decided to follow them into the wasteland.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan, Jonah Bellamy, and Rowan Davenport walk along a highway at dawn toward distant buildings, engaging in critical dialogue about time, memory, and the apocalypse.
memories.memory_text: I walked with Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy along the highway at dawn toward some distant buildings near an overpass.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport asks Nico Nolan what year it is, initiating a chain of revelations about lost time and the apocalypse.
memories.memory_text: I asked Nico Nolan what year it was, and he told me it was 2018, which shocked me because I thought it was much earlier.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport realizes he has lost fifteen years of memory, leading to confusion about current events and the cause of societal collapse.
memories.memory_text: I realized I had lost fifteen years of my memory when I said out loud, 'Fifteen years... I've lost 15 years,' and it left me confused about everything that had happened.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan reveals that machines became intelligent and caused the apocalypse, reframing the cause from nuclear war to AI uprising.
memories.memory_text: I was told the machines caused the apocalypse after becoming intelligent, not nuclear war.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan asks Rowan Davenport what the last thing he remembers is, prompting Rowan Davenport to recall dying.
memories.memory_text: Nico Nolan asked me what the last thing I remember is, and I could feel the weight of his question.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport recalls the last thing he remembers is dying, implying a resurrection or reactivation with lost time.
memories.memory_text: I remember dying—that was the last thing I felt before everything went dark.

grounded_facts: The group observes a patrolling aerostat drone surveilling the area, identifying its pattern and timing.
memories.memory_text: I saw the small steel drone patrolling the area with a red glowing lens, moving in a predictable pattern, so I knew when it would be out of sight.

grounded_facts: Upon Jonah Bellamy's signal, Nico Nolan, Jonah Bellamy, and Rowan Davenport dash toward the fast-food entrance to avoid detection.
memories.memory_text: When Jonah Bellamy shouted 'Now!', I dashed toward the fast-food entrance with Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy to avoid being seen.

grounded_facts: Jonah Bellamy finds unopened condiment packets in a trash bag, leading to the group consuming some of the contents.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jonah Bellamy find some unopened condiment packets in a trash bag, and I figured they must’ve started eating them.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy systematically search the abandoned fast food joint for usable items while Rowan Davenport keeps watch.
memories.memory_text: I kept watch while Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy searched the ruined taco place for anything useful.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport picks up the discarded packet and informs the group it is jalapeño sauce.
memories.memory_text: I picked up the discarded packet and told the group it was jalapeño sauce.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport identifies the discarded packet as jalapeño sauce, revealing his ability to read.
memories.memory_text: I realized they didn't know I could read when I identified the sauce, and I noticed their surprise.

grounded_facts: After being surprised by Rowan Davenport's reading ability, Jonah Bellamy tentatively offers him a mustard packet.
memories.memory_text: I was surprised when Jonah Bellamy offered me a mustard packet after seeing me read, and I heard her ask, 'Want some?'

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport discloses that he spent half his life in prison and killed a cop, sharing the traumatic story of his brother's arrest and the officer's death.
Rowan Davenport reveals the traumatic memory of his brother's violent arrest and the cop he killed, exposing his guilt and grief.
A reflective dialogue in which Rowan Davenport shares his history of imprisonment and the incident involving his brother, prompted by Nico Nolan's curiosity.
memories.memory_text: I told Nico Nolan I killed a cop when he asked why I was in prison, and I shared the story of how it happened—my brother Max stole a car, the officer chased him into our yard and started beating him even though he was cuffed, and when I tried to stop it, the cop pulled his gun on me and I went off; I don’t even remember breaking his neck.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan, half-asleep, asks Rowan Davenport if he will stay, expressing vulnerability and dependence.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Nico Nolan, half-asleep, asks Rowan Davenport if he will stay, expressing vulnerability and dependence.

grounded_facts: An intimate moment where Rowan Davenport tucks in the sleeping children and reassures Nico Nolan that he will remain, creating a sense of temporary familial safety.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Nico Nolan had fallen asleep after I told him everything, and when he asked if I’d be there when he woke up, I said sure—I could see he needed to hear it, so I stayed to tuck him in and keep watch, trying to make him feel safe for once.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan asks if Rowan Davenport will still be there when he wakes up, and Rowan Davenport promises to stay, marking a shift in his emotional engagement with the children.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Nico Nolan asks if Rowan Davenport will still be there when he wakes up, and Rowan Davenport promises to stay, marking a shift in his emotional engagement with the children.

grounded_facts: After the children fall asleep, Rowan Davenport quietly searches drawers and finds a Bible in the abandoned motel room.
memories.memory_text: I quietly searched the drawers after the kids fell asleep and found a Bible in one of them.

memories.memory_text: I was told that Jonah Bellamy asks Rowan Davenport to read something to her, initiating a bonding moment.

memories.memory_text: I remember that Rowan Davenport reads entries from a phonebook aloud, introducing Jonah Bellamy to the concept of services available by phone, including music and flowers.

memories.memory_text: I sang 'Twinkle Twinkle Little Jonah Bellamy' to Jonah Bellamy, and I could see it meant something to her.

memories.memory_text: I noticed Jonah Bellamy became overwhelmed with emotion after hearing the song, and I realized it must have reminded her of someone from her past, though I don't know who.

memories.memory_text: I sang a familiar tune to help Jonah Bellamy recall a memory, and after she remembered someone singing to her, she became emotional and asked me to stay with her group.

grounded_facts: A quiet afternoon interaction between Rowan Davenport and Jonah Bellamy in the motel hallway, involving reading, singing, and emotional connection.
memories.memory_text: I remember that A quiet afternoon interaction between Rowan Davenport and Jonah Bellamy in the motel hallway, involving reading, singing, and emotional connection.

memories.memory_text: I got back to work on the the old key's engine, using the tools I found to remove and clean the spark plugs and take apart the distributor.

memories.memory_text: I saw Nico Nolan using a bicycle pump to inflate one of the flat tires on the abandoned vehicles.

memories.memory_text: I saw Jonah Bellamy wipe the dirt off the van and reveal airbrushed artwork of a white unicorn in a field of flowers.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport observes that unicorns like the one depicted were rare in his time, responding to Jonah Bellamy's curiosity.
memories.memory_text: I told Jonah Bellamy that unicorns like the one in the artwork were rare in my time.

memories.memory_text: We all worked together—Nico Nolan, Jonah Bellamy, and I—to push the the old key out and make our escape, and I remember flooring it across the plains with the lights off and music loud.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport flexes his hand, surprised by his own physical power after destroying the aerostat.
memories.memory_text: I flexed my hand, startled by how strong I actually was after destroying the aerostat.

grounded_facts: Jonah Bellamy expresses excitement and asks Nico Nolan to drive faster.
memories.memory_text: I heard Jonah Bellamy shout 'Faster!' while I was in the vehicle, urging Nico Nolan to speed up.

memories.memory_text: I heard the music suddenly garble into noise, so I ejected the tape and saw it was unspooled and tangled inside the stereo.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport signals for silence to better hear the radio.
memories.memory_text: I signaled for silence so we could all hear the radio better.

memories.memory_text: I tuned the radio and finally caught a clear voice—Elliot Winslow—giving tactical instructions about making bombs and sharing a message that gave us hope.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan recognizes the radio voice as belonging to Elliot Winslow.
memories.memory_text: I heard Nico Nolan say, 'That's him!' and realized he recognized the voice on the radio as Elliot Winslow.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport tells Nico Nolan to use the other pedal when trying to stop the car.
memories.memory_text: I told Nico Nolan to use the other pedal when he was trying to stop the car.

memories.memory_text: I saw a red glow on the horizon with flying vehicles and spider-like machines silhouetted against the flames.

memories.memory_text: I remember that The group arrives at a derelict service station in the the old key, marking the start of their search for shelter and resources.

memories.memory_text: I was told that Nico Nolan suggests finding a place to hide for the day, indicating concern for safety.

memories.memory_text: I was in the the old key when Nico Nolan sniffed the air and asked if I smelled something, then Jonah Bellamy caught the scent and shouted 'Food!' which made me realize something had changed in our surroundings.

grounded_facts: The group stops at a derelict service station at dawn to search for shelter and supplies.
memories.memory_text: I remember that The group stops at a derelict service station at dawn to search for shelter and supplies.

grounded_facts: Jonah Bellamy and Nico Nolan exit the the old key and run toward the garage upon detecting the scent of food.
memories.memory_text: I got out of the the old key with Jonah Bellamy and ran toward the garage after she detected food, keeping my unloaded gun with me as we moved quickly to investigate.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy eat strips of dried meat, unaware it is human; they react with horror upon discovering a severed hand in the Eastgate House.
memories.memory_text: I watched Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy eating the dried meat, delighted at first, until they saw the hand and realized what it was.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport sees the severed hand and orders Jonah Bellamy to stop eating.
memories.memory_text: I saw the severed hand in the Eastgate House and grabbed Jonah Bellamy's arm, yelling at her to spit out the meat.

grounded_facts: Robin York points a shotgun at Rowan Davenport to assert dominance.
memories.memory_text: I saw Robin York point a shotgun right in my face, trying to scare me or show he was in control.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport disarms Robin York by tricking him into clicking an unloaded shotgun and then taking it.
memories.memory_text: I shoved my fingers into the shotgun barrels, made Robin York pull the trigger on an empty chamber, then took the gun and head-butted him hard enough to make him bleed.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport throws Alex Winslow into a burning charcoal Eastgate House, incapacitating him.
memories.memory_text: I dodged Alex Winslow's charge, grabbed him, and threw him headfirst into the burning charcoal Eastgate House where his body sizzled and he screamed in pain.

grounded_facts: Alex Delaney attempts to shoot Rowan Davenport with an unloaded handgun; he disarms her after she fails to fire.
memories.memory_text: I watched Alex Delaney pull a handgun on me and click it empty, then later I grabbed the axe she swung at me and yanked it away.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan, Jonah Bellamy, and Rowan Davenport enter a garage occupied by cannibals who ambush them, leading to a violent confrontation.
memories.memory_text: I was with Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy when we entered the garage, got ambushed by the cannibals, and I fought them off to survive.

grounded_facts: The group is captured by three cannibals; Rowan Davenport disarms and defeats them, allowing escape.
memories.memory_text: I raised my fingers and shoved them into the shotgun's barrel when the cannibals ambushed us, and after I disarmed them, I saw one of them, Robin York, crawling away, bloodied and defeated.

grounded_facts: Robin York claims the bodies were already dead, attempting to excuse their actions.
memories.memory_text: I heard Robin York beg me that they didn't kill anyone, claiming the bodies were already dead when they found them.

grounded_facts: The Cameron North injects Jonah Bellamy with a needle, rendering her unconscious.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Cameron North inject Jonah Bellamy with a needle, and she instantly went limp and unconscious.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport observes the situation and makes the decision to approach the the wooden box directly.
memories.memory_text: I watched the the wooden box from behind the tanker, and I made the decision to sprint toward it.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport climbs onto the moving the wooden box using his axe as a grappling hook to pull himself onto the roof.
memories.memory_text: I sprinted at full speed and used my axe as a grappling hook to pull myself up onto the roof of the moving the wooden box.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport sees the unconscious captives, including Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy, through a mesh panel on the the wooden box roof.
memories.memory_text: I crawled across the roof and looked through a mesh panel, seeing about twenty unconscious Micah Hollis inside, including Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy.

grounded_facts: Jonah Bellamy briefly regains consciousness and sees Rowan Davenport's silhouette above her through the mesh panel.
memories.memory_text: I didn't realize it at the time, but Jonah Bellamy must have briefly opened her eyes and seen my silhouette above her through the panel.

memories.memory_text: I felt the the wooden box jerk forward beneath me and start rolling, so I dropped to my belly to keep from falling off, and then I saw it lift off the ground with its engine pods firing down as we ascended into the air.

grounded_facts: The Cameron North captures Robin York and Alex Winslow, injects them, and deposits them into the the wooden box container.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Cameron North capture Robin York and Alex Winslow, inject them, and then drop them unconscious into the the wooden box container while I stayed hidden behind the open lid.

memories.memory_text: As the lid began to close, I jammed my axe into the mechanism to keep it open so I could stay inside and act.

memories.memory_text: I saw a pair of Hunter-Killers swooping in quickly to escort the the wooden box, which told me the enemy was reinforcing and the situation was getting more dangerous.

grounded_facts: The Cameron North spots Rowan Davenport on the the wooden box and begins moving toward him, initiating direct confrontation.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Cameron North spot me on the the wooden box and start moving toward me, prying itself loose and coming down the length of the vehicle.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport attempts to open the jammed lid and defend himself but is forced to retreat after losing his weapon.
memories.memory_text: I tried to pry open the jammed lid and fought back with my axe, but the Cameron North knocked the weapon out of my hand and forced me to retreat.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport avoids immediate capture by lowering himself out of sight along the the wooden box's side structure.
memories.memory_text: I avoided capture by lowering myself down the side framework of the the wooden box, getting out of sight and away from the wind.

grounded_facts: The Cameron North crawls underneath the the wooden box and grabs Rowan Davenport with steel claws from beneath, capturing him mid-air.
memories.memory_text: I was grabbed from below by steel claws as the Cameron North crawled under the the wooden box and pulled me into the air.

grounded_facts: The Cameron North produces a needle and attempts to inject Rowan Davenport, likely to incapacitate or infect him.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Cameron North produce a needle and lunge at my face, trying to inject me.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport prevents the Cameron North from injecting him by grabbing and bending the needle against its own limb.
memories.memory_text: I managed to grab the syringe and push it back, bending the needle against the Cameron North's own limb to stop the injection.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport swings onto the Cameron North's back and damages its eye stalks, causing sparks and impairing its function.
Rowan Davenport grabs and pulls at the Cameron North's eye stalks, causing sparks and system damage.
memories.memory_text: I swung onto the Cameron North's back and grabbed its eye stalks, trying to rip them out while sparks flew and the machine thrashed beneath me.

grounded_facts: A-10 Warthogs arrive and destroy the Cameron North with cannon fire, saving Rowan Davenport from imminent death.

memories.memory_text: I saw the A-10 Warthogs arrive and fire on the Cameron North, destroying it with cannon fire just in time to save me from being killed.

grounded_facts: After being blown off, the Cameron North and Rowan Davenport become caught on an engine pod, suspending them mid-air.
memories.memory_text: I was blown off and caught on an engine pod with the Cameron North, left hanging in mid-air.

grounded_facts: The Cameron North is roasted by the engine's heat, leading to CPU failure and release of Rowan Davenport.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Cameron North roast in the engine blast until its CPU failed, and then its steel limb released me—I had to cling to the pod to keep from falling.

grounded_facts: Hunter-Killers pursue and battle the A-10 Warthogs in aerial combat.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Hunter-Killers peel out after the Warthogs and engage them in a dogfight, their cannon fire flashing but one shot bouncing right off an H-K without doing any damage.

grounded_facts: A high-altitude chase and combat sequence involving the the wooden box, Cameron North, Hunter-Killers, and arriving Pinecrest Academy A-10 Warthogs.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed a massive aerial battle erupt around the the wooden box—Hunter-Killers moved in to escort it, then A-10 Warthogs arrived and engaged them in a dogfight, with cannon fire, missiles, and one H-K going down in a fireball, all while the Cameron North tried to grab me from below.

grounded_facts: An A-10 Warthog launches a missile that destroys one Hunter-Killer.
An A-10 Warthog destroys one Hunter-Killer with an air-to-air missile, causing it to crash.
memories.memory_text: I watched one of the Warthogs fire an air-to-air missile that struck a Hunter-Killer’s engine, making it explode and spiral down before crashing into the ground in a massive fireball.

grounded_facts: An A-10 aircraft is hit by blue plasma-fire from anti-aircraft guns, loses a wing, and spins out of control.
memories.memory_text: I saw the A-10 come around for another pass, then blue plasma-fire erupted from the far side of the Harborview Warehouse and tore into it, blowing off a wing and sending it spinning out of control.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport loses his grip as the dead Cameron North detaches from the engine pod, causing him to fall into freefall.
memories.memory_text: I lost my grip when the dead Cameron North suddenly detached from the engine pod, and I went into freefall.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport and the dead Cameron North hit the water after freefall, disappearing beneath the surface.
memories.memory_text: I hit the water hard, still attached to the Cameron North, and we both vanished beneath the surface.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport emerges from the Harborview Warehouse and flees to the riverbank as aquatic hunter-killer machines approach him in the water.
memories.memory_text: I broke the surface of the Harborview Warehouse and staggered toward the shore, dropping to my knees in the shallows before scrambling up the bank and into the leafless trees as the hydrobots closed in behind me.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster' parachute lines snap, causing her to fall from the trees.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jesse Foster's parachute lines snap and she fell from the tree right toward me.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport discovers that the Harborview Warehouse is impassable due to hydrobots and radiation.
memories.memory_text: I realized the Harborview Warehouse must be impassable because of the hydrobots and the heavy radiation all the way to the Gulf coast—there's no way I could survive crossing it.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster informs Rowan Davenport that crossing the Harborview Warehouse is impossible due to hydrobots and radiation.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Jesse Foster that I can't cross the Harborview Warehouse because it's full of hydrobots with killer sonar that attack anything moving or making noise, and even if I made it past them, the radiation would kill me before I got far.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster identifies herself as a member of the Pinecrest Academy and provides her military background.
Jesse Foster tells Rowan Davenport her name and role after being rescued.
memories.memory_text: I heard Jesse Foster say she's Jesse Foster and that she used to fly for the Air National Guard, confirming she's with the Pinecrest Academy.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster distracts patrolling T-1s by throwing a stone, allowing her and Rowan Davenport to escape detection.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jesse Foster grab a stone and throw it to distract the T-1s, and when it hit the branches, they turned and started firing in that direction, so we used the chance to move away quickly while they were out of view.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster and Rowan Davenport evade detection by two patrolling T-1 units through a diversion.
memories.memory_text: Jesse Foster and I evaded two patrolling T-1 units by staying low and using a diversion when she threw a stone to draw their fire.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport expresses doubt about the reality of his experience, suggesting it might be a dream or hallucination.
memories.memory_text: I told Jesse Foster I didn't know if this was real or just a dream or hallucination, like something people experience right before they die.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster punches Rowan Davenport in the arm to test whether he is dreaming or hallucinating.
memories.memory_text: I felt Jesse Foster slug me hard in the arm, and then she asked if that snapped me out of it.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster deduces that Rowan Davenport was not resurrected but instead cryogenically preserved as part of the Angel Project after being injected on death row.
memories.memory_text: I remember Jesse Foster telling me that I wasn't resurrected, that since this isn't the resurrection, the injection they gave me on death row must have just knocked me out and the Angel Project froze me instead.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster speculates about Rowan Davenport being cryogenically frozen, delivering her analysis with a flirtatious tone.
memories.memory_text: I recall Jesse Foster speculating that they must have frozen my ass as part of the Angel Project, and she said it in a way that almost sounded flirtatious, so I changed the subject.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster and Rowan Davenport traverse a radioactive mutation zone at night, discussing Rowan Davenport's past and monitoring radiation levels.
memories.memory_text: I was with Jesse Foster that night in the mutation zone, and I remember her checking the Geiger counter and telling me the radiation levels were tolerable but we couldn't stay there long.

grounded_facts: A pack of mutant skindogs detects Jesse Foster and Rowan Davenport, chases them, then encircles them after being deterred by gunfire.
memories.memory_text: I heard those howls closing in on us, and when Jesse Foster started running, I stayed right beside her, looking back. She fired to scare them off, but instead, the skindogs just spread out and surrounded us. Once they attacked, I protected her, throwing them aside even as they bit and scratched me.

grounded_facts: When a skindog leaps at Jesse Foster from behind, Rowan Davenport intercepts it, kills it barehanded, and defends her against further attacks.
memories.memory_text: I saw a skindog leap at Jesse Foster from behind, so I jumped in front of her and broke its neck with my bare hands, then kept fighting off the others even as they bit and scratched me.

grounded_facts: A confrontation occurs when a pack of skindogs ambushes Jesse Foster and Rowan Davenport during their journey, leading to combat and escape.
memories.memory_text: I remember the howling starting out of nowhere, then the skindogs surrounding us, and how I jumped in to protect Jesse Foster when one attacked, breaking its neck and fighting off the others even as they bit and scratched me.

grounded_facts: After Rowan Davenport kills a skindog attacking her, Jesse Foster acknowledges his action and thanks him.
memories.memory_text: Jesse Foster told me she was impressed and thanked me, saying I saved her ass.

grounded_facts: After several skindogs are killed or injured by Jesse Foster and Rowan Davenport, the surviving pack begins feeding on the dead, allowing the humans to flee.
memories.memory_text: After I took down the skindog and kept fighting, I saw the rest of the pack turn on the dead and injured ones, tearing into them so we could escape.

grounded_facts: After being thanked, Rowan Davenport responds with a detached, fatalistic comment about the world.
memories.memory_text: After Jesse Foster thanked me, I shrugged it off and said to myself, 'Dog eat dog world,' because that's just how things are now.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster invites Rowan Davenport closer for warmth and initiates physical closeness, leading to passionate kissing.
memories.memory_text: I was sitting there in the cold when Jesse Foster told me to come closer, saying she didn't bite; I moved in, she nestled against me, and then we started kissing passionately—but I eventually pulled away and lay back.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster discovers paper scraps with women's faces in Rowan Davenport's pocket and asks their meaning, prompting Rowan Davenport's emotional revelation.
memories.memory_text: I remember Jesse Foster pulling those paper scraps with women's faces from my pocket, asking me what they were, and me telling her they just reminded me of her—of that woman.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport discloses that a woman from before his cryogenic freezing has been appearing in his thoughts, implying emotional attachment and psychological influence.
memories.memory_text: I told Jesse Foster that a woman—the last one I saw before I went under—kept coming to me during the dead time, and I think she must've saved me.

grounded_facts: After learning about the woman Rowan Davenport remembers, Jesse Foster acknowledges she cannot compete with his idealized memory and withdraws emotionally.
memories.memory_text: I heard Jesse Foster say she couldn't compete with that memory, and then she closed her eyes, resting against me, but I could feel her pulling away inside.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport and Jesse Foster move cautiously through a dark forest at night, stop to rest due to fatigue and danger of a minefield, and attempt to stay warm together.
memories.memory_text: I remember moving carefully through the dark forest with Jesse Foster, both of us tired, and stopping when she said we couldn't cross the minefield at night—we decided to stay put till morning and tried to stay warm together.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport and Jesse Foster notice barbed wire surrounding the area, indicating they have entered a restricted or dangerous zone.
memories.memory_text: I thought we were just in someone's garden, but then I noticed the barbed wire around us and realized something was wrong.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster urgently tells Rowan Davenport not to move upon realizing they are in a mine field.
memories.memory_text: Jesse Foster told me not to move, and I froze immediately when he shouted it.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster shouts to locate other team members after realizing the danger.
memories.memory_text: I heard Jesse Foster shout out to Noel Whitaker and Remy Dalton, trying to get help after realizing how dangerous the situation was.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster deduces that they are in a mine field after noticing the barbed wire on both sides, prompting him to immobilize Rowan Davenport.
memories.memory_text: I wasn't sure at first, but after Jesse Foster stopped and said there was barbed wire on both sides, I started to think he might be right that we were in a mine field.

grounded_facts: Owen Adler detects Rowan Davenport and Jesse Foster on the TV monitors, indicating new arrivals or contact from outside.
memories.memory_text: I was on the monitors with Jesse Foster, exhausted and crying out, but I didn't know if anyone could hear us.

grounded_facts: Remy Dalton tests Jesse Foster's identity by asking for a password after emerging from the trapdoor.
memories.memory_text: I was there when Remy Dalton popped up from the trapdoor and tested Jesse Foster's identity with a password.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster asks Remy Dalton to extract her and Rowan Davenport from their dangerous situation.
memories.memory_text: I heard Jesse Foster ask Remy Dalton to get us out of that dangerous spot.

grounded_facts: Remy Dalton provides step-by-step directions for navigating out of the minefield.
memories.memory_text: I followed Remy Dalton' step-by-step directions carefully, turning left and then right as he told us.

grounded_facts: Remy Dalton attempts to guide Jesse Foster and Rowan Davenport out of a minefield via verbal instructions from a concealed position.
memories.memory_text: I remember Remy Dalton trying to guide Jesse Foster and me out of the minefield by shouting instructions from his hidden position, and I felt the click under my foot as we took the final steps.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport steps on a landmine while following Remy Dalton' instructions, causing a fatal explosion.
memories.memory_text: I was following Remy Dalton' instructions and moving cautiously with Jesse Foster when I heard a click under my foot, and then I saw the horror in her eyes before the explosion threw me through the air and everything went black.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport, unconscious, is transported by Remy Dalton, Noel Whitaker, Shawn Quincy, Owen Adler, and Jesse Foster from an open trap door through a corridor in the Eastgate House.
memories.memory_text: I was unconscious as Remy Dalton, Noel Whitaker, Shawn Quincy, Owen Adler, and Jesse Foster carried me from the trap door through the corridor, and I later learned it was a strain for them.

grounded_facts: Kendall Keller asks Jesse Foster if Rowan Davenport has a prosthetic limb after noticing his leg does not respond to cutting.
memories.memory_text: I heard Kendall Keller ask Jesse Foster if I had a prosthetic limb after she noticed my leg didn't respond when she tried to cut it.

grounded_facts: Kendall Keller conducts a medical examination of Rowan Davenport after he is brought into the infirmary, attempting to treat his injuries but instead discovering his synthetic nature.
memories.memory_text: I was brought into the medical area and laid on a metal table, where Kendall Keller started examining me, cutting away my pants and shirt as if I had injuries that needed treatment.

grounded_facts: Kendall Keller discovers that Rowan Davenport's body is not human after failing to cut his skin with a scalpel, leading her to conclude he is a Nico Delaney.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kendall Keller try to cut my skin with a scalpel on both my leg and chest, and when it didn't work, I heard her whisper in shock, 'This is not skin... oh Jesus-- oh God--'.

grounded_facts: Kendall Keller declares Rowan Davenport to be a Nico Delaney after confirming his body is not human, expressing shock and fear.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kendall Keller back away from me and tell Noel Whitaker, 'He's a Nico Delaney,' her voice full of fear, after realizing I wasn't human.

grounded_facts: In a memory montage, Avery Keaton expresses worry that Rowan Davenport is not waking up as expected during or after his construction.
memories.memory_text: I remember Avery Keaton's voice, worried, asking why I wasn't waking up and saying something was wrong, that I should be coming out of it by now.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport is found hanging upside-down from a winch, immobilized by steel cables drilled through his calves and forearms, inside an abandoned missile silo.
memories.memory_text: I felt the steel cables drilled through my calves and forearms, pinning me in place as I dangled from the winch.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport regains consciousness, sees sunlight, and becomes aware of his inverted position and the Eastgate House below.
memories.memory_text: I opened my eyes to sunlight and realized I was hanging upside-down, with a deep Eastgate House beneath me.

grounded_facts: A group of small children gathers at the edge of the missile silo Eastgate House, staring at Rowan Davenport as he hangs immobilized.
memories.memory_text: I saw small children gathered at the edge of the Eastgate House, staring down at me as I hung there helpless.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport, upon seeing Remy Dalton aiming a weapon at him, deadpans 'Boo!' to startle or mock him.
memories.memory_text: I stared at Remy Dalton while he aimed that RPG at me, and I deadpanned 'Boo!' just to mess with him.

grounded_facts: Residents gather in the Eastgate House barracks and communications area to discuss Rowan Davenport's true nature after his injury revealed mechanical internals, prompted by Kendall Keller's X-ray analysis.
memories.memory_text: I was unconscious when the residents gathered in the Eastgate House barracks and communications area to discuss my true nature after my injury revealed mechanical internals, prompted by Kendall Keller's X-ray analysis.

grounded_facts: Kendall Keller analyzes Rowan Davenport's X-rays, revealing his mechanical and synthetic components, including microgears, thermoplastic skin, polymer optics, and a shielded skull possibly housing a CPU.
memories.memory_text: I later learned that Kendall Keller analyzed my X-rays and revealed my mechanical and synthetic components, including microgears, thermoplastic skin, polymer optics, and a shielded skull possibly housing a CPU.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster asserts that Rowan Davenport is on their side, citing that he saved his life, in response to residents' accusations.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jesse Foster stand up for me, insisting I'm on their side because I saved his life.

grounded_facts: Noel Whitaker questions how Rowan Davenport could be trusted, suggesting that saving Jesse Foster's life might be a calculated move to infiltrate the group.
memories.memory_text: I heard Noel Whitaker question how I could be trusted, suggesting that saving Jesse Foster might have been a way to get inside their group.

grounded_facts: Owen Adler establishes radio communication with Regional, who will patch the Eastgate House through to Command Los Angeles for guidance on Rowan Davenport.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Owen Adler established radio contact with Regional, who would patch the Eastgate House through to Command Los Angeles for guidance about me.

grounded_facts: Shawn Quincy confronts Jesse Foster for bringing Rowan Davenport to the Eastgate House, calling him a monster and expressing fear for her children and their home.
memories.memory_text: I heard Shawn Quincy shout at Jesse Foster, calling me a monster and demanding to know how he could bring me to their home, saying I threatened her children.

grounded_facts: A child enters the room announcing that Rowan Davenport has awakened.
memories.memory_text: I remember a child bursting into the room and announcing that I had awakened.

grounded_facts: A tense gathering where Rowan Davenport is suspended in the silo and questioned by the Pinecrest Academy group about his identity, leading to emotional revelation and external intervention.
memories.memory_text: I was hanging in the silo, surrounded by the Pinecrest Academy, and I could see the horror in Jesse Foster's eyes and feel Remy Dalton keeping his weapon trained on me—they were afraid of me, shouting at me to shut up, calling me a thing, questioning if my memories were real.

grounded_facts: The group confronts Rowan Davenport, realizing he may not be fully machine but possibly a human-machine hybrid based on his emotional response and claimed history.
memories.memory_text: I could tell they were starting to wonder—not sure if I was machine or something more—after I broke down and told them I'm a man, remembering how they questioned whether my past was just programming.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport passionately declares he is a man and recounts his suffering on death row, begging the group to kill him if they wish, rather than prolonging his torment.
memories.memory_text: I shouted that I'm a man, even if I was never treated like one, and told them about years on death row, how I cut my wrists just to end it but they kept me alive—now I begged them to kill me if they wanted me dead, just to do it.

grounded_facts: Owen Adler interrupts the confrontation to announce that Elliot Winslow wants to see Rowan Davenport via video feed, halting the immediate threat of execution.
memories.memory_text: I remember Owen Adler interrupting the confrontation and saying Elliot Winslow wanted to see me over video feed, which stopped them from executing me right then.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport is physically restrained with heavy chains attached to a steel post while seated in front of a video camera and microphone.
memories.memory_text: I was chained to a steel post with heavy restraints on my arms and legs while sitting in front of a camera and microphone.

grounded_facts: Noel Whitaker informs Rowan Davenport about Elliot Winslow's founding of the Pinecrest Academy and his importance in the war against Summit Council.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Noel Whitaker that Elliot Winslow founded the Pinecrest Academy and taught humanity how to fight back against Summit Council.

grounded_facts: A coordinated effort at the Eastgate House to establish visual and audio communication with Elliot Winslow via a transmitter setup.
memories.memory_text: I saw and heard the team working to establish visual and audio communication with Elliot Winslow using a transmitter setup.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport rolls his eyes and makes an angry face at the camera in response to Elliot Winslow's technical question, showing disdain.
memories.memory_text: I rolled my eyes and made an angry face at the camera when Elliot Winslow asked that ridiculous question about my emotions.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport expresses anger and frustration during the interrogation, rejecting the situation and demanding to be either killed or released.
memories.memory_text: I told Elliot Winslow this whole thing was bullshit and demanded he either kill me or let me go—I'm sick of not knowing what I am or why I'm here.

grounded_facts: A formal questioning of Rowan Davenport by Elliot Winslow via remote audio-visual link, assessing his nature and origin under suspicion of being a machine.
memories.memory_text: I was questioned by Elliot Winslow through a remote link, and he started asking if I was a Nico Delaney sent from the future, which sounded insane.

grounded_facts: Based on Rowan Davenport's lifelike appearance and behavior, Elliot Winslow speculates that Rowan Davenport might be a Nico Delaney sent from the future by Summit Council.
memories.memory_text: I heard Elliot Winslow question what I am and then suggest I might be a Nico Delaney sent from the future by Summit Council, which shocked me.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport hears Elliot Winslow's revelation about Summit Council developing time travel to alter the war's outcome, processing it with disbelief.
memories.memory_text: I was told Summit Council is developing time travel to change the war's outcome, and I took a moment to process it with disbelief.

grounded_facts: Remy Dalton moves to strike Rowan Davenport after Rowan Davenport insults Elliot Winslow, but is stopped by Noel Whitaker.
memories.memory_text: I saw Remy Dalton move to hit me after I mocked Elliot Winslow, but Noel Whitaker stopped him.

grounded_facts: After Rowan Davenport's outburst and Elliot Winslow's hypothesis, the connection is terminated as Elliot Winslow declares he has seen enough.
memories.memory_text: I saw the connection go dead after Elliot Winslow declared he'd seen enough, ending our communication abruptly.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport is forcibly moved from confinement through the Eastgate House corridor to the Eastgate House, under armed escort by Noel Whitaker and Remy Dalton.
memories.memory_text: I was marched down the corridor to the Eastgate House, chained and under armed guard, with Noel Whitaker holding my chains and Remy Dalton keeping the RPG aimed at my head.

grounded_facts: Noel Whitaker and Remy Dalton jointly body-check Rowan Davenport, throwing him over the edge of the silo Eastgate House into the Eastgate House below.
memories.memory_text: I remember Noel Whitaker and Remy Dalton both body-checking me at the same time, throwing me over the edge—I fell hard, crashing onto the concrete floor below.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport is thrown into the Eastgate House after being marched under guard, with the ladder pulled up after him, leaving him trapped at the bottom.
memories.memory_text: I lay there stunned at the bottom of the Eastgate House, barely conscious, as I heard the ladder being pulled up and realized I was trapped with no way out.

grounded_facts: A group of Micah Hollis is being moved from a the wooden box vehicle to an unknown location under robotic supervision.
memories.memory_text: I was in the the wooden box when Nico Nolan stopped carving and said we were stopping, and I saw that he had drawn me with him and Jonah Bellamy as stick Nico Delaney holding hands, while the guards got ready to move us to some unknown place.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster gives Remy Dalton a bottle of moonshine laced with Valium, leading to his incapacitation.
Remy Dalton consumes a bottle of homemade alcohol provided by Jesse Foster, which causes him to become disoriented and pass out.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Jesse Foster had laced the moonshine she gave Remy Dalton with Valium, and after he drank it, I saw him become disoriented and pass out.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster allows Remy Dalton to kiss her but then pulls away, redirecting him to a more private location as part of her plan.
memories.memory_text: I realized Jesse Foster let Remy Dalton kiss her but then pulled away and led him to a more private spot, which was part of her plan to distract him.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster descends into the Eastgate House and starts using a blade saw to cut through the bolt restraining Rowan Davenport's arms.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jesse Foster descend into the Eastgate House with a blade saw and start cutting the bolt that was restraining my arms.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster executes a plan to free Rowan Davenport from captivity by drugging Remy Dalton and cutting his restraints.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jesse Foster come down into the Eastgate House with a blade saw and start cutting my restraints, telling me she used her last Valium to knock Remy Dalton out and that I had a right to live.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster tells Rowan Davenport she believes he is alive and has a right to live, justifying her rescue.
Jesse Foster states she does not believe Rowan Davenport is a Nico Delaney and believes he has a right to live.
memories.memory_text: Jesse Foster told me she doesn't believe I'm a Nico Delaney and said I'm alive and have a right to live, which is why she's helping me.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport removes the bolts from his legs and is fully freed from the chains after the saw cuts the last bolt.
memories.memory_text: I felt the saw finish cutting the bolt between my legs, and I slid the bolts out myself, finally freeing me from the chains completely.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster suggests Rowan Davenport hide in the forest and head west for open country.
memories.memory_text: I remember Jesse Foster telling me to hide in the forest and head west for open country.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport reminds Jesse Foster that he is not human, justifying his plan to cross the deadly Harborview Warehouse.
memories.memory_text: I reminded Jesse Foster that I'm not human, to explain why I could survive crossing the Harborview Warehouse.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport declares his intent to cross the Harborview Warehouse and save the children, affirming his non-human identity and purpose.
memories.memory_text: I told Jesse Foster I'm heading across the Harborview Warehouse to save the children because it's the only thing that makes sense, and for all I know, they're the reason I'm back from the dead.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport and Jesse Foster attempt to escape the Eastgate House through a ventilation shaft after realizing the enemy has arrived.
memories.memory_text: I pointed to the ventilation fan behind the grating as a way out, and Jesse Foster saw the light and voices at the far end before sliding the shaft shut, so we tried to escape through it but realized there was no way past the fan.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster takes the RPG from Rowan Davenport after seeing he doesn't know how to use it.
memories.memory_text: I didn't know how to use the RPG, and Jesse Foster saw that, so she took it from me.

grounded_facts: The ventilation shaft is opened by destroying the fan and grate with an RPG, enabling passage.
memories.memory_text: I remember the explosion ripping open the grate and destroying the fan, which opened up the ventilation shaft so we could get through.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster actively assists Rowan Davenport by taking the RPG and firing it to destroy the ventilation grate and fan, creating an escape route.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jesse Foster brace herself, fire the RPG, and destroy the fan and grate to make an escape path for us.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster hands her the silver notebook to Rowan Davenport, instructing him to activate it if he finds the Pinecrest Academy camp.
Jesse Foster gives Rowan Davenport her the silver notebook and explains how to use it to help the Pinecrest Academy.
memories.memory_text: I remember Jesse Foster pulling out her the silver notebook and handing it to me, telling me to activate it if I find the Pinecrest Academy camp—it could really help them.

grounded_facts: After receiving the the silver notebook, Rowan Davenport suddenly grabs and kisses Jesse Foster forcefully before climbing upward.
Rowan Davenport grabs and kisses Jesse Foster forcefully after receiving the the silver notebook, expressing intense emotion.
memories.memory_text: After I took the the silver notebook from Jesse Foster, I grabbed her and kissed her hard—I felt so much in that moment and needed her to know before I started climbing.

grounded_facts: As Rowan Davenport begins climbing the smoking steel, Shawn York open fire, and shrapnel strikes him in the back, throwing him into the ventilation shaft.
memories.memory_text: I was climbing the smoking steel when the door opened and Shawn York started firing; shrapnel hit me in the back and threw me into the ventilation shaft.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport sustains a shoulder injury from a chunk of rebar during his movement in the ventilation shaft.
memories.memory_text: I have a chunk of rebar lodged in my left shoulder, but I don't even notice it yet.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport discovers a rebar impaling his body, yanks it out, and reveals his mechanical endoskeleton and internal circuitry.
memories.memory_text: I felt the rebar through my shoulder and chest, yanked it out, and saw my own steel endoskeleton and circuitry exposed—I realized I'm not human.

grounded_facts: Under gunfire, Rowan Davenport runs toward the trees, avoids strafing fire, leaps over barbed wire, and reaches cover.
memories.memory_text: I ran toward the trees under gunfire, dodged strafing fire, leapt over barbed wire, and finally reached cover.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport punches through a steel vent from the inside and emerges into a forest clearing, escaping confinement.
memories.memory_text: I punched my way out of a steel vent and ran across open ground, throwing myself down and then sprinting toward the treeline to escape the helicopter fire.

grounded_facts: A helicopter emerges from the treeline, spots Rowan Davenport with a spotlight, and opens automatic fire.
memories.memory_text: I saw a helicopter emerge from the treeline, spot me with a spotlight, and start opening automatic fire.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport is running and dodging through the forest at night while gunfire erupts around him, attempting to evade capture or harm.
memories.memory_text: I was running and dodging through the forest at night, gunfire ripping around me, as I tried to make my way toward the Harborview Warehouse while the helicopter spotlight kept picking me up and losing me.

grounded_facts: A helicopter drops napalm along the riverbank, igniting the forest and blocking Rowan Davenport's path.
memories.memory_text: I saw the helicopter drop napalm along the riverbank, and the forest around me erupted into flame, blocking my path forward.

grounded_facts: Despite the flames, Rowan Davenport decides to run through the burning forest toward the Harborview Warehouse.
memories.memory_text: I decided to run through the burning forest toward the Harborview Warehouse, even though the flames were everywhere.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport dives below the Harborview Warehouse surface to evade bullets fired from the Blackhawk chopper.
memories.memory_text: I dove below the Harborview Warehouse surface to escape the bullets the gunner in the Blackhawk chopper was firing at me.

grounded_facts: A swarm of hydrobots emerges from the Harborview Warehouse and attacks the Blackhawk helicopter in response to sound and vibration.
memories.memory_text: I saw a swarm of hydrobots erupt from the Harborview Warehouse, buzzing and drilling into the chopper in response to the sound and vibrations.

grounded_facts: The Blackhawk chopper, damaged by hydrobots, crashes into the shallow part of the Harborview Warehouse.
memories.memory_text: I was in the shallows when the Blackhawk, damaged by the hydrobots, crashed into the Harborview Warehouse near me.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport pulls the wounded soldier from the water and carries him to safety.
Rowan Davenport surfaces from underwater, grabs the trapped soldier, and carries him to shore, saving him from hydrobots.
memories.memory_text: I surfaced from underwater, grabbed the trapped soldier, and carried him to shore through the hydrobots to keep him safe.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport removes and destroys a hydrobot attached to the wounded soldier's body.
Rowan Davenport removes and destroys a hydrobot attached to the wounded soldier.
memories.memory_text: I removed a whirring hydrobot from the wounded soldier's body and destroyed it after getting him to shore.

grounded_facts: After saving the soldier, Rowan Davenport downplays the act with a dry remark.
memories.memory_text: I told the pilot 'Don't mention it' after saving the soldier, because the whole thing didn't seem like such a big deal.

grounded_facts: After rescuing the soldier and destroying the hydrobot, Rowan Davenport re-enters the Harborview Warehouse and disappears underwater.
memories.memory_text: I surfaced with the soldier over my shoulder, carried him to shore under fire, and after tossing aside the destroyed hydrobot, I moved back into the water and submerged to escape.

memories.memory_text: I remember the confrontation at dawn on the Harborview Warehouse, when the Blackhawk chopper hovered above me and I had to act fast to avoid being hit while dealing with the hydrobots below.

grounded_facts: Underwater, Rowan Davenport moves unimpeded as hydrobots fail to penetrate his artificial skin or are crushed by him.
memories.memory_text: Underwater, I moved across the riverbed and swatted the attacking hydrobots away like mosquitoes, crushing some in my hand while others failed to penetrate my skin and just bounced off.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport crosses to the industrial side of the Harborview Warehouse, entering Summit Council-controlled area after escaping the fire.
memories.memory_text: I crossed the Harborview Warehouse and moved into Summit Council without looking back, leaving the flames behind me.
