The Nico Delaney points its weapon and scans Rowan Davenport, then disengages upon identifying him as non-organic.
memories.memory_text: I came face to face with a Skeletal Nico Delaney that pointed its plasma rifle at me and scanned me; I saw its red eyes glow as it read me as non-organic, then it simply turned away and ignored me.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport resumes moving forward despite the harsh environment of Summit Council.
memories.memory_text: I shook my head and kept moving forward along the edge of the embankment, pushing through the harsh conditions of Summit Council.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport moves past defensive installations and descends into the area beyond Summit Council's outer wall.
memories.memory_text: I moved past anti-aircraft guns and missile launchers, staying clear of the Nico Delaney legions patrolling near the riverside as I descended beyond Summit Council's outer wall.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport witnesses the activation and arming of a newly built Nico Delaney, appearing shocked.
memories.memory_text: I saw the newly built Nico Delaney activate and get armed, and I could feel my shock taking over—I was completely dumbfounded.

grounded_facts: An ongoing industrial operation in which Nico Delaney components are robotically assembled, including endoskeleton construction, CPU installation, synthetic skin application, and final activation.
memories.memory_text: I saw an industrial operation with robotic assembly lines building Terminators—conveyors moving parts, robots soldering electronics and hydraulics, and steel presses stamping out limbs and torsos.

grounded_facts: A Nico Delaney is activated after its CPU is inserted into the skull and sealed, with red eyes lighting up and the unit beginning autonomous movement.
memories.memory_text: I watched as a Nico Delaney's red eyes lit up after the CPU was inserted, and it started moving on its own, released by the armature.

grounded_facts: The activated Nico Delaney takes a plasma weapon from a rack and joins a group of identical units boarding a the old box for deployment.
memories.memory_text: I saw the activated Nico Delaney take a plasma weapon from a rack and join a group of identical units boarding a the old box for deployment.

grounded_facts: A high-speed convoy of modified Summit Council trucks carrying construction materials moves through a narrow street in Summit Council, forcing all other units to clear the path.
memories.memory_text: I saw a high-speed convoy of massive Summit Council trucks bearing down on me, forcing everything else to clear the path as they raced through the narrow street.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport narrowly avoids being crushed by the lead Summit Council truck by throwing himself flat on the street, allowing the vehicle to pass over him.
memories.memory_text: I threw myself flat on the street and pressed my body down just in time, feeling the lead Summit Council truck pass over me with its wheels missing me by inches.

grounded_facts: A subsequent Summit Council truck catches Rowan Davenport with a steel crossmember, dragging him beneath the vehicle and tearing off chunks of flesh.
memories.memory_text: I felt the steel crossmember catch my back as the truck dragged me underneath, tearing chunks of flesh from my body.

grounded_facts: Despite severe injury, Rowan Davenport crawls forward and clings to a forward portion of the truck's undercarriage to avoid being ground into the pavement.
memories.memory_text: I crawled forward and clung to the front part of the undercarriage, trying to keep myself from being ground into the pavement even though my left leg was twisted and dragging behind me.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport takes advantage of the truck slowing down during a turn to launch himself from beneath the vehicle and roll into the gap between the convoy and the concrete wall.
memories.memory_text: I took advantage of the truck slowing down during a turn to launch myself from beneath it and roll into the gap between the convoy and the concrete wall.

grounded_facts: After hearing another convoy approaching, Rowan Davenport finds a seam in the concrete and climbs over the eight-foot-high freeway wall to the other side.
memories.memory_text: I heard another convoy approaching and, limping from my damaged leg, I found a seam in the concrete wall that gave me enough purchase to climb over the eight-foot-high barrier and get to the other side just as the trucks rumbled past below.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport sees a container among the trucks carrying Micah Hollis, recognizing their faces and reaching hands, which prompts a strong reaction.
memories.memory_text: I saw a container among the trucks with people inside, their faces full of anguish and hands reaching out, and it hit me hard—I had to react.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport observes the convoy disappearing around a curve and sees a complex of buildings in the distance, recognizing it as the destination.
memories.memory_text: I watched the convoy disappear around a curve and saw a complex in the distance, realizing that’s where they were headed, so I started moving toward it.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport arrives at a lush coastal valley community, limping as he descends a gentle slope toward the settlement.
memories.memory_text: I arrived at a lush coastal valley community, limping as I made my way down a gentle slope toward the settlement, amazed by what looked like a paradise.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport emerges from the trees and encounters Riley Huxley, a golfer who offers help after noticing his damaged condition.
memories.memory_text: I emerged from the trees onto a golf course, disoriented, and turned toward a noise—someone approaching in a golf cart. Riley Huxley stopped beside me, got out, and looked me over, clearly noticing the exposed metal at my shoulder and leg.

grounded_facts: Riley Huxley observes Rowan Davenport's exposed mechanical parts and realizes he is severely damaged.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Riley Huxley looking me over carefully, and when he said I looked like I'd been hit by a truck, I realized he could see how badly I was damaged.

grounded_facts: An unplanned meeting between Rowan Davenport and Riley Huxley on a golf course, leading to assistance and transportation.
memories.memory_text: I encountered Riley Huxley unexpectedly on the golf course; he noticed my damaged state, we exchanged words, and he offered me help and a ride to the Westhaven Street.

grounded_facts: Riley Huxley sees Rowan Davenport in distress and offers him a ride to the Westhaven Street.
memories.memory_text: After seeing my condition, Riley Huxley offered me a ride to the Westhaven Street, saying, 'The Westhaven Street, sure. Hop in, I'll take you there.'

grounded_facts: After brief hesitation, Rowan Davenport accepts Riley Huxley's offer to ride to the Westhaven Street where the children were taken.
memories.memory_text: I hesitated for a moment, wondering if I could trust Riley Huxley, but he seemed eager to help, so I accepted his offer to ride to the Westhaven Street where the children were taken.

grounded_facts: Riley Huxley introduces himself by name and extends a handshake.
memories.memory_text: I remember Riley Huxley introducing himself and reaching out to shake my hand, which I accepted.

grounded_facts: Riley Huxley attempts to shake Rowan Davenport's hand but cannot establish a neural or digital connection due to damage.
memories.memory_text: I felt Riley Huxley try to connect with me through the handshake, but I could sense it wasn't working—something in my interface was damaged.

grounded_facts: After failing to connect, Riley Huxley reassures Rowan Davenport that he will be repaired soon.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Riley Huxley that he couldn't connect with me because my interface was damaged, but he reassured me that I'd be repaired soon.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport realizes the trail mix he ate is not real food but a foam resin, leading to confusion and disbelief.
memories.memory_text: I realized the trail mix I ate was actually some kind of foam resin, not food at all, and it left me confused and disbelieving.

grounded_facts: Riley Huxley offers Rowan Davenport trail mix, which Rowan Davenport takes and eats before realizing it's not real food.
memories.memory_text: I took the trail mix Riley Huxley offered me and ate it, not realizing it wasn't real food until I spat it out and saw what it was.

grounded_facts: Riley Huxley explains that he and others are hybrids whose brains are powered by fuel cells, not biological needs.
memories.memory_text: Riley Huxley told me he and others are hybrids whose brains are powered by fuel cells, not biological needs, and that’s why they don’t need to eat real food.

grounded_facts: Riley Huxley opens a panel beneath his rib cage to replace an empty trail mix bag with a full one, revealing his cybernetic body.
memories.memory_text: I saw Riley Huxley lift his shirt and click open a panel beneath his rib cage, revealing circuits and fiber-optics inside, and then he replaced an empty trail mix bag with a full one before closing it again.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport identifies the robotic workers as 'Terminators', invoking a loaded historical term.
Rowan Davenport recognizes the gardener and window washer as Casey Nolan models and exclaims 'Terminators!', causing social tension.
memories.memory_text: I saw the gardener and window washer working outside the house and recognized them as Casey Nolan models, and I exclaimed 'Terminators!' because that's what they looked like to me.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport grabs Riley Huxley and demands to know what he is, showing fear and distrust.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed Riley Huxley and demanded, 'What are you?'—I was scared and didn't know who or what he really was.

grounded_facts: Riley Huxley gives Rowan Davenport a ride through an upscale neighborhood populated by hybrids and service robots, serving as an orientation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Riley Huxley drive me through an upscale neighborhood filled with hybrids and service robots, and when I reacted to the T-400s working, he confirmed this was a community for people like him.

grounded_facts: Riley Huxley tells Rowan Davenport they are both hybrids—part human, part machine—revealing Rowan Davenport's own transformed nature.
memories.memory_text: Riley Huxley told me he's a hybrid, just like me—that I'm part human, part machine—and I realized this changed everything about who I thought I was.

grounded_facts: Riley Huxley explains that negative emotions trigger artificial endorphin release, making him smile despite grief.
memories.memory_text: I learned that when Riley Huxley feels negative emotions like grief or rage, his body automatically releases artificial endorphins to make him feel better, which is why he smiles even in pain.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport violently confronts Riley Huxley, demanding to know how the group arrived at the Westhaven Street.
memories.memory_text: I slammed on the brakes and demanded that Riley Huxley tell me how they got here, grabbing him by the throat to make sure he understood I wasn't asking politely.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport grabs Riley Huxley by the throat and drags him from the cart to force him to reveal information.
memories.memory_text: I dragged Riley Huxley from the cart by his throat, squeezing hard because I needed answers and force was the only thing that would get them.

grounded_facts: Riley Huxley describes how human neural functions were transferred into artificial bodies as part of Project Angel.
memories.memory_text: I heard Riley Huxley explain how they transferred human neural functions into artificial bodies as part of Project Angel, converting analog brain signals into digital commands.

grounded_facts: Riley Huxley explains that Project Angel involved replacing human bodies with synthetic systems to support the brain for extreme environments.
memories.memory_text: Riley Huxley told me that Project Angel was about replacing human bodies with synthetic systems to support the brain for extreme environments, like deep space or the ocean floor.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport and Riley Huxley travel along a wooded path toward the Westhaven Street, during which key information is exchanged and tensions rise.
memories.memory_text: I remember moving through the trees with Riley Huxley, the tension building as we made our way toward the Westhaven Street, both of us knowing more was at stake than just the journey.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport uncovers that the park's natural elements are fake—plastic trees, astroturf, and hidden bones beneath the surface.
memories.memory_text: I heard birdsong and looked up to find a tiny speaker hidden in the leaves, and when I touched the tree, it felt wrong—fiberglass, hollow. I rapped it with my fist and knew it wasn't real. The leaves wouldn't bend—they were plastic. Then I crouched down and found a seam in the grass, peeled it back, and saw it was just astroturf over sand and dirt. I kept pulling it up and found bones—skulls, legbones—buried underneath. I couldn't believe it, but I saw it with my own eyes. I kept moving toward the complex, stunned but determined to find out what really happened here.

grounded_facts: Avery Keaton expresses apparent relief and affection upon seeing Rowan Davenport, calling the Westhaven Street 'paradise'.
memories.memory_text: I remember Avery Keaton seeing me and saying, 'Rowan Davenport... it is you. You're alive, you found us. Welcome to paradise,' but I knew it wasn't paradise—it was a lie.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport condemns the Westhaven Street as a graveyard, rejecting Avery Keaton's vision of a new world.
memories.memory_text: I told her the truth straight to her face—I said, 'It's a graveyard,' because that's exactly what this place felt like to me.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport is confronted by Avery Keaton outside the Westhaven Street entrance, leading to his capture.
memories.memory_text: I was confronted by Avery Keaton outside the Westhaven Street entrance, and though I didn't return her embrace, I remember her pressing something to my neck—then everything went black.

grounded_facts: Avery Keaton embraces Rowan Davenport and uses a device to knock him unconscious.
Avery Keaton embraces Rowan Davenport and then incapacitates him with a taser-like device.
memories.memory_text: I didn't return her embrace when she came toward me, and then she pressed something to the base of my skull—zapped me—and I went limp; I remember falling, her letting me down before I blacked out.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport hides an the silver notebook in the bushes near the office park Westhaven Street.
memories.memory_text: I hid the the silver notebook Blaire gave me in the bushes and activated it, seeing the green light pulse before moving on.

grounded_facts: Avery Keaton tells Rowan Davenport to calm down during his awakening and distress.
memories.memory_text: I remember Avery Keaton telling me to calm down while I was waking up and struggling on the table.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport accuses Avery Keaton and her group of serving Summit Council and using him as a test subject.
memories.memory_text: I accused Avery Keaton of using me as a guinea Robin York and serving Summit Council while I was strapped to that table.

grounded_facts: Avery Keaton explains that Summit Council is a tool created to save humanity through transformation into hybrids.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Avery Keaton explain that Summit Council is a tool designed to save humanity by transforming us into hybrids to prevent extinction.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport is informed that Summit Council was created to prevent human extinction by transforming humanity into hybrids.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Summit Council was created to prevent human extinction by transforming humanity into hybrids.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport's detached leg is surgically reattached after repairs.
memories.memory_text: I saw my detached leg being repaired by surgical machines, and later I felt it being reattached to my body while I was still restrained and awake.

grounded_facts: The back of Rowan Davenport's skull is opened to reveal his human brain connected to circuitry.
memories.memory_text: I felt the table tilt and saw the tools come at me, cutting into the back of my head—I could feel them burning through, exposing my brain as I struggled against the restraints.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport pleads and struggles against the neural interface installation.
memories.memory_text: I screamed at them to stop, begging and straining against the bonds because I didn't want this—telling them they were dead inside for doing this to me.

grounded_facts: An automated surgical session in which Rowan Davenport is repaired and modified using machines under Avery Keaton's remote supervision.
memories.memory_text: I woke up clamped to a surgical table while machines repaired my body under Avery Keaton's remote control, and I felt helpless as they cut into my head and attached an electronic module to my exposed brain.

grounded_facts: An electronic interface module is attached to Rowan Davenport's exposed brain.
memories.memory_text: I felt something cold and mechanical being fixed to the base of my exposed brain—the interface they were forcing onto me.

grounded_facts: A late-night work period at the Westhaven Street where hybrids, including Rowan Davenport and Avery Keaton, are active.
memories.memory_text: I was on the late shift at the Westhaven Street, walking with Avery Keaton and passing other hybrids, feeling more at ease than I had in a long time.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport feels a new emotional state—happiness—facilitated by Avery Keaton, which he struggles to articulate.
memories.memory_text: I felt something new while walking with Avery Keaton, a feeling I couldn't quite name, and when she asked how I was, I told her I didn't know how to describe it.

grounded_facts: Avery Keaton helps Rowan Davenport identify his emotional state as happiness, framing it as a contrast to his lifelong anger and isolation.
memories.memory_text: Avery Keaton helped me understand that what I was feeling was happiness, something I'd never known because I'd spent my life angry and isolated.

grounded_facts: Avery Keaton clasps Rowan Davenport's hand in both of hers, triggering a strong emotional and sensory response in him.
memories.memory_text: I felt a jolt of something intense when Avery Keaton clasped my hand in both of hers, closing my eyes as it washed over me.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport undergoes an intense neural sensation through the implanted interface at the base of his skull, described by Avery Keaton as 'pure ecstasy' and available on demand.
memories.memory_text: I felt an overwhelming wave of pleasure surge through me from the implant at the base of my skull, and I remember Avery Keaton calling it 'pure ecstasy'—something we could share together on demand.

grounded_facts: Avery Keaton asks Rowan Davenport if he was bored during the neural experience, reinforcing the shared intimacy and ensuring his positive response.
memories.memory_text: Avery Keaton asked me if I was bored during the experience, and I shook my head because I was far from it—I was completely immersed.

grounded_facts: Avery Keaton redirects the meaning of the neural experience from hedonism to intellectual pursuit, framing scientific exploration as the true joy of their community.
Avery Keaton reframes the purpose of the neural interface from pleasure to intellectual exploration, positioning scientific discovery as the highest form of satisfaction for the community.
memories.memory_text: I remember Avery Keaton telling me that even though the neural interface can give me pleasure anytime, she said most of us here are scientists and that our real joy comes from using our minds to explore and discover.

grounded_facts: Avery Keaton leads Rowan Davenport from the outdoor park area into one of the office buildings, initiating a transition into a new physical and narrative space.
memories.memory_text: I saw Avery Keaton lead me up the steps and into one of the buildings, moving us from the park into a new space.

grounded_facts: Avery Keaton informs Rowan Davenport about significant advancements in nanotechnology and polymimetic metals achieved through collaboration with Summit Council.
Avery Keaton tells Rowan Davenport about the advanced technological breakthroughs achieved with Summit Council, including nanotechnology and polymimetic metals.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Avery Keaton that she's been working with Summit Council and making amazing breakthroughs in nanotechnology and polymimetic metals, far beyond anything possible before Judgment Day.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport learns that the Westhaven Street has developed a functional time machine, capable of sending individuals back in time, though currently limited to a few days.
memories.memory_text: I learned from Avery Keaton that the Westhaven Street has a working time machine, though it can only send people back a few days at most, and I realized then that Elliot Winslow had been right all along.

grounded_facts: Avery Keaton reacts with sudden interest and suspicion when Rowan Davenport mentions having heard Elliot Winslow speak, probing his connection.
memories.memory_text: I mentioned that I'd heard Elliot Winslow speak, and I could see Avery Keaton's interest shift suddenly—she looked at me with suspicion and asked if I knew him, probing me right away.

grounded_facts: Avery Keaton characterizes Elliot Winslow, the Pinecrest Academy leader, as dangerous and delusional, claiming his fight ultimately serves death rather than salvation.
Avery Keaton labels Elliot Winslow as dangerous and delusional, framing his Pinecrest Academy as a fight for death rather than salvation.
memories.memory_text: Avery Keaton told me that Elliot Winslow is dangerous and delusional, saying he fights not for salvation but for death, and I remember her words clearly because they chilled me.

grounded_facts: Avery Keaton shows Rowan Davenport the time displacement chamber and its operational time sphere, explaining its current capabilities.
memories.memory_text: I saw the time displacement chamber myself when Avery Keaton showed me—the glowing blue sphere set into the floor, the loud hum, and the digital clock counting down—then I looked back at it as we left, trying to take it all in.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport and Avery Keaton walk across the Westhaven Street campus at night, engaging in a conversation about Summit Council's true purpose and limitations.
memories.memory_text: I walked across the campus with Avery Keaton at night, the quiet surroundings making the conversation feel more intense.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport asks Avery Keaton why survivors aren't told the truth about Summit Council's hybrid program.
memories.memory_text: I asked Avery Keaton why the survivors outside aren't told the truth about Summit Council's hybrid program, since they think it's just trying to destroy them.

grounded_facts: Avery Keaton explains to Rowan Davenport that Summit Council cannot support more than a few thousand human-machine hybrids, limiting who can be saved or transformed.
memories.memory_text: Avery Keaton told me that Summit Council can't support more than a few thousand human-machine hybrids, which is why not everyone can be saved or transformed like us.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport brings up that people he knew were taken to the Westhaven Street, implying emotional investment and suspicion about selection criteria.
memories.memory_text: I remember bringing up how some people I knew were picked up and taken to the Westhaven Street, and I started wondering why they were chosen.

grounded_facts: Avery Keaton accesses the system to display recently arrived minds for Rowan Davenport to identify.
memories.memory_text: I watched as Avery Keaton moved to a computer terminal and told it to display recent arrivals for processing, and then I saw images of faces appear on the screen, each with a barcode, and I leaned in to look closely.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport identifies Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy among recent arrivals in the neural net; learns Nico Nolan has been processed into the network while Jonah Bellamy was terminated.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy appear on the screen among the new arrivals, and when I touched their faces, I learned Nico Nolan had been processed into the network—Avery Keaton said I could connect with him—but Jonah Bellamy was terminated, and that caused me real pain before she took my hand and I found some comfort.

grounded_facts: Avery Keaton expresses sympathy for Jonah Bellamy's death and physically comforts Rowan Davenport by holding his hand, helping him regain composure.
memories.memory_text: I felt the pain of Jonah Bellamy's death, and when Avery Keaton told me she didn't suffer, she held my hand and I managed to smile, saying I understood.

grounded_facts: Due to an external disturbance, Avery Keaton ends her interaction with Rowan Davenport and departs, leaving him alone.
memories.memory_text: I was still with Avery Keaton when the building shook from an explosion; she let go of my hand, listened to her earpiece, and after I asked what was happening, she said she had to go and left me alone.

grounded_facts: After learning of Jonah Bellamy's death and seeing his reflection, Rowan Davenport violently removes the interface module from his skull, rejecting the system.
memories.memory_text: After learning Jonah Bellamy was gone and seeing what I'd become, I fought through the pain and ripped the interface from my skull, rejecting everything it stood for.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport dives out of the way to avoid being hit by a fast-moving futuristic ATV.
memories.memory_text: I was moving across the campus when sudden headlights hit me, so I dove out of the way to avoid being hit by a fast-moving ATV.

grounded_facts: An armed assault involving fire, smoke, and military vehicles attacking the office park Westhaven Street.
memories.memory_text: I saw fire and smoke in the distance with vehicles moving fast through the destruction, and then a futuristic ATV and a the old box came roaring past, making it clear the Westhaven Street was under attack.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport urgently demands to go back in time, pressing the Terry Hale for instructions.
memories.memory_text: I urgently told the Terry Hale I needed to go back in time and asked him what to do, pressing him for instructions because I believed he knew how to activate the sphere.

grounded_facts: A group of Morgan Carver storm the Time Displacement Chamber, opening fire and disrupting the attempt to send Rowan Davenport back in time.
memories.memory_text: I saw the door burst open and Morgan Carver storming in, opening fire and disrupting everything just as I was trying to go back.

grounded_facts: The Terry Hale is shot through the chest by a Nico Delaney, causing visible damage to his plastinated body, but he remains conscious and dismissive.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed a Nico Delaney shoot the Terry Hale through the chest, blowing a huge hole in his plastinated body, but he stayed conscious and seemed dismissive of the injury.

grounded_facts: The Terry Hale steps in front of Rowan Davenport and yells at the Terminators not to shoot inside the chamber due to the danger.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Terry Hale step in front of me and yell at the Terminators not to shoot inside the chamber because it was too dangerous.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport leaps into the center of the time sphere just before it is struck by plasma fire, initiating a temporal displacement sequence.
memories.memory_text: I leapt into the center of the time sphere just as the Nico Delaney fired, feeling energy erupt around me and my clothing burning off as the blue light surrounded me.

grounded_facts: The plastic tree has been melted by intense heat, resembling a candle, with drips surrounding Rowan Davenport.
memories.memory_text: I saw the plastic tree around me melting like a candle, drips of it falling from the heat that came with my arrival.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport appears naked 20 feet in the air in the park, surrounded by foliage and fading blue energy, then plummets to the ground.
memories.memory_text: I appeared naked in the air above a park, surrounded by foliage and fading blue energy, then I plummeted to the ground and rolled.

grounded_facts: After landing, Rowan Davenport recognizes the nearby Westhaven Street and moves in its direction.
memories.memory_text: I landed in the park area and tried to get my bearings; I recognized the Westhaven Street nearby and moved toward it.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport takes advantage of the opening gate to infiltrate the garage by crawling underneath before it closes.
memories.memory_text: I took advantage of the opening garage gate, crawling underneath it before it closed to get inside the Westhaven Street undetected.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport uses his strength to force open the glass doors, gaining access to a new area.
memories.memory_text: I used all my strength to pry open the glass doors and get through.

grounded_facts: The Taylor Arden determines that subject 32582 (Jonah Bellamy) is borderline and may not be emotionally compatible, deciding to pass on her.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Taylor Arden examine Jonah Bellamy's file and say she was borderline and might not be emotionally compatible, so he decided to pass on her—and then I watched him throw her baseball cap into the trash.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport, armed with a robotic laser arm, demands the Taylor Arden release the captives.
memories.memory_text: I pointed my robotic laser arm at the Taylor Arden and demanded he let the captives go, shouting at him when he didn't respond.

grounded_facts: When the Taylor Arden attempts to trigger an alarm, Rowan Davenport uses his laser arm to sever the Taylor Arden's hand.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Taylor Arden reach for the alarm button, so I fired my laser arm and severed his hand to stop him.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport fires the laser again, decapitating the Taylor Arden, whose head rolls to Rowan Davenport's feet.
memories.memory_text: I fired the laser again and saw the Taylor Arden's head tumble off, bounce, and roll to my feet.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport threatens to destroy the Taylor Arden's brain by pulling the interface, causing the Taylor Arden to freeze in fear.
Rowan Davenport threatens to destroy the Taylor Arden's brain by disconnecting the interface, forcing compliance.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed the interface at the base of the Taylor Arden's neck and told him I'd pull it off, threatening to destroy his brain, and when he froze in fear, I forced him to make his body release the captives.

grounded_facts: The Taylor Arden's body, under coercion, aborts the system, opening the chambers and freeing the Micah Hollis.
memories.memory_text: I saw the headless body of the Taylor Arden tap the controls under my command, and then the machines powered down with 'ABORT' flashing on the screens as the chambers began to open and free the Micah Hollis.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport demands and receives the Taylor Arden's clothes, which the headless body begins to remove.
memories.memory_text: I told the Taylor Arden's head in my hand that I'd need his clothes, and I watched his body start unbuttoning the shirt right away.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan exits his chamber and rushes to Jonah Bellamy, who awakens in his arms.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico Nolan get out of his chamber and rush to Jonah Bellamy, who woke up in his arms.

grounded_facts: A violent confrontation in the laboratory leads to the forced release of captives from stasis chambers.
memories.memory_text: I demanded the Taylor Arden release the captives, and when he didn't comply, I used my laser to sever his hand, took control of his head, and forced him to abort the system and open the chambers—I even gave Jonah Bellamy back her cap after I rescued it from the trash.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport gives Jonah Bellamy back her baseball cap, which he retrieved from the trash.
memories.memory_text: I handed Jonah Bellamy her baseball cap back after getting it from the trash.

grounded_facts: Jonah Bellamy puts on her cap and tells Rowan Davenport she knew he would come.
memories.memory_text: I gave Jonah Bellamy her cap and she put it on, telling me she knew I would come.

grounded_facts: The released Micah Hollis, including Nico Nolan, Jonah Bellamy, and Rowan Davenport, flee the laboratory.
memories.memory_text: I said we had to get out of there, and then I fled the laboratory with Nico Nolan, Jonah Bellamy, and the others.

grounded_facts: A hydrogen car driven by Alex Winslow is shot and explodes, causing nearby characters to flee and shaking the building.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Nico Delaney shoot Alex Winslow's hydrogen car, and it exploded right near me, shaking the building and forcing me to flee with Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport declares he is not human to avoid being targeted by the Nico Delaney.
memories.memory_text: I told the Nico Delaney I'm not human so it wouldn't target me.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport prevents a Nico Delaney from pursuing Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy, then disarms and destroys it.
Rowan Davenport physically intervenes to block a Nico Delaney from targeting Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy.
memories.memory_text: I leapt at the Nico Delaney to block it from going after Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy, wrenched the rifle from its grasp, and blew its head off to stop it.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan ignores Rowan Davenport's warning about driving and asserts his ability.
memories.memory_text: I told Nico Nolan he couldn't drive, and he shot back 'Watch me!' before taking off.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan takes control of a futuristic ATV with Jonah Bellamy as passenger, initiating their escape.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico Nolan roar up on a futuristic ATV with Jonah Bellamy clinging to him, and with no time to argue, I jumped into the back beside Jonah Bellamy as Nico Nolan gunned it out of there, careening off walls and other vehicles.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport attempts to disable the pursuing the old box with a plasma rifle, but the armor resists damage.
memories.memory_text: I fired my plasma rifle at the the old box, but the blasts barely scratched its armor.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan narrowly avoids colliding with a burning, overturned stolen bus on the path.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico Nolan swerve hard to avoid that burning bus lying on its side just ahead of us.

grounded_facts: Jonah Bellamy sees Rowan Davenport in the headlights and appears to recognize him, expressing surprise.
memories.memory_text: Jonah Bellamy saw me in the headlights and looked surprised, like she recognized me, and I told her it was a long story.

grounded_facts: An automated the old box opens fire on escaping vehicles, destroying part of a building wall.
memories.memory_text: I saw the the old box fire and miss us, blowing a chunk of the building wall apart with its plasma blast.

grounded_facts: A high-speed chase involving Nico Nolan, Rowan Davenport, and Jonah Bellamy on an ATV, pursued by a the old box through the office park Westhaven Street.
memories.memory_text: I was riding with Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy on the ATV, trying to outrun the the old box through the office park.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan narrowly avoids a direct hit from the the old box's plasma fire by oversteering and recovering balance.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico Nolan oversteer to dodge the the old box's plasma fire, lifting us onto two wheels before he pulled us back under control.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport shoots and eliminates Morgan Carver appearing in the path.
memories.memory_text: I stood my ground and fired over Nico Nolan's head, blowing the Morgan Carver out of the way to clear our path.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport points and tells Nico Nolan to take a specific path to continue the escape.
Rowan Davenport identifies and instructs Nico Nolan to take a specific escape route near the park.
memories.memory_text: I pointed toward the park and told Nico Nolan to take that path, directing him along the escape route we needed to follow.

grounded_facts: A high-speed evasion sequence in which the group flees the the old box by entering the woods.
memories.memory_text: I was with the group as we fled the the old box by speeding into the woods, dodging trees while the the old box couldn't follow and instead set the forest on fire behind us.

grounded_facts: The ATV strikes a tree and topples over, spilling the passengers.
memories.memory_text: I remember the ATV striking a tree and toppling over, spilling me and the others onto the ground.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport checks if the others are unharmed after the crash.
memories.memory_text: I checked on the others right after the crash, asking if they were all right.

grounded_facts: Jonah Bellamy implies Nico Nolan is a poor driver after the crash, prompting a defensive response.
memories.memory_text: I heard Jonah Bellamy imply I should drive instead of Nico Nolan, questioning his driving after the crash.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport assumes control of the ATV by taking the wheel after the crash.
memories.memory_text: I took control of the ATV by righting it and grabbing the wheel so we could keep moving.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport sharply steers the ATV onto a lawn to evade incoming fire from the the old box.
memories.memory_text: I sharply steered the ATV onto a lawn to evade incoming fire from the the old box.

grounded_facts: The ATV, driven by Rowan Davenport, crashes through a picture window of a house after swerving off the street.
memories.memory_text: I crashed through a picture window of a house after swerving off the street.

grounded_facts: The the old box's plasma blast fires upward, penetrating the floor of the upper level and narrowly missing Rowan Davenport.
memories.memory_text: I saw the plasma blast tear up through the floor just behind me, missing me by seconds as I raced across the upper level.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport rides the ATV up the stairs, through the master bedroom, and onto the balcony to escape the destruction.
memories.memory_text: I rode the ATV up the stairs, through the master bedroom, and straight out onto the balcony, crashing through the railing to get clear.

grounded_facts: A the old box smashes through the house, destroying walls, rooms, and burying a Taylor Hart in rubble.
memories.memory_text: I was on the ATV, launching off the balcony into the air, and I realized the the old box had smashed through the house, destroying walls and rooms and burying a Taylor Hart in the rubble.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan asks Rowan Davenport where they are going, seeking information about their current trajectory.
memories.memory_text: I remember Nico Nolan asking me where we were going, looking to me for answers about our path.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport identifies the destination by pointing toward the marina and a boat moored at the dock.
memories.memory_text: I pointed toward the marina and the boat moored at the dock to show Nico Nolan where we were headed.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport steers the ATV down a slope toward the shoreline, changing their direction and location trajectory.
memories.memory_text: I steered the ATV down the slope toward the shoreline, guiding us in the direction of the boat.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport protected Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy by placing himself in front of them, taking a plasma blast that knocked him into the water.
memories.memory_text: I threw myself in front of Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy to shield them from the plasma blast, and I remember the impact as it blew me into the water.

grounded_facts: Jonah Bellamy seized the plasma rifle and shot the Morgan Carver in the back, then destroyed its head as it emerged from the water.
memories.memory_text: I was blown into the water by a plasma blast, and when I climbed back onto the dock, I saw that Jonah Bellamy had seized the plasma rifle and shot the Morgan Carver in the back, then destroyed its head as it emerged—she must have reacted the moment it passed by us.

grounded_facts: After emerging from the water, Rowan Davenport's damaged body revealed exposed metal, torn face, and missing eye, confirming his artificial nature.
memories.memory_text: I saw my own body after emerging from the water and realized my shoulder, arm, and hand were showing exposed metal, my face was partially torn away, and I was missing one eye.

grounded_facts: Jonah Bellamy raised the plasma rifle at Rowan Davenport after seeing his mechanical form, warning him not to approach.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jonah Bellamy raise the plasma rifle at me and heard her shout, 'Don't come any closer!' when she saw what I looked like.

grounded_facts: A final confrontation unfolded as a Nico Delaney army advanced, only to be countered by an unexpected aerial assault.
memories.memory_text: I heard a whistling sound and saw a missile destroy the boat and part of the dock, then I looked up and saw a whole army of Terminators and tanks advancing toward us.

grounded_facts: A missile strike from shore destroyed the motorboat and damaged a large section of the dock.
memories.memory_text: I heard a whistling sound from shore and hit the deck just as a missile blast destroyed the motorboat and tore apart a large section of the dock.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport, Nico Nolan, and Jonah Bellamy attempted to flee via motorboat but were intercepted by a Nico Delaney and forced into combat.
memories.memory_text: I sprinted with Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy toward the motorboat, trying to escape, but I saw red eyes and the glow of a plasma rifle charging at the end of the dock, so I knew we were in trouble.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport, in a distorted whisper, expressed regret to Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy after being revealed as a machine.
memories.memory_text: I turned to Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy, my voice a distorted whisper as I said, 'I'm sorry,' knowing they had seen what I really was.

grounded_facts: After Rowan Davenport apologized, Jonah Bellamy lowered her weapon and hugged him, showing acceptance.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jonah Bellamy put her rifle down and then she touched my exposed metal before hugging me tightly, accepting me despite what I am.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan looked out to sea and noticed a large black shape rising, which gave him a hopeful expression.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico Nolan look out to sea, and his expression changed to something hopeful as a huge black shape rose in the distance.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport provides critical intelligence about the location of additional Micah Hollis to the arriving forces.
Rowan Davenport informs the Alex Nolan about additional Micah Hollis located inland.
memories.memory_text: I told the arriving Alex Nolan about the additional Micah Hollis inland, sharing what I knew—I said there were more Micah Hollis at a complex about a mile in.

grounded_facts: Elliot Winslow is revealed to be among the arriving Shawn York, removing his mask and introducing himself to Nico Nolan.
Elliot Winslow reveals his identity to Nico Nolan by removing his mask and offering a handshake.
memories.memory_text: I saw Elliot Winslow arrive with the Shawn York and remove his mask to introduce himself to Nico Nolan, offering a handshake and saying, 'I'm glad you made it.'

grounded_facts: Elliot Winslow acknowledges his earlier misjudgment of Rowan Davenport and offers an apology.
Elliot Winslow acknowledges his past mistake in judging Rowan Davenport and offers an apology.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Elliot Winslow that he owed me an apology for misjudging me, and I replied with a dry 'Get in line,' knowing he wasn't the only one who'd been wrong about me.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport dismisses the doctor's attempt to examine his facial injury, claiming he feels nothing and telling the doctor to help others.
memories.memory_text: I told the doctor I don't feel a thing and told him to help somebody else instead of focusing on my facial injury.

grounded_facts: A group of rescued Micah Hollis is being processed and treated aboard a submarine, with personnel arriving from outside.
memories.memory_text: I saw a group of rescued Micah Hollis being brought aboard the submarine, with personnel arriving from outside to help process and treat them.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport interrupts Elliot Winslow to state that the people in the houses are no longer human.
memories.memory_text: I interrupted Elliot Winslow to say that the people in the houses are not people anymore.

grounded_facts: The submarine's hull is punctured near the floor due to Rowan Davenport's discharged plasma rifle, causing water to flood in.
memories.memory_text: I saw the plasma rifle discharge and blow a hole in the sub's hull near the floor, and water started gushing in like a firehose.

grounded_facts: Elliot Winslow is hit in the lower abdomen by Avery Keaton's plasma weapon while shielding Elliot Hale, causing critical injury.
memories.memory_text: I saw Elliot Winslow step in front of Elliot Hale to shield her from Avery Keaton, and then I saw him get hit in the lower abdomen by her plasma weapon—he was thrown backward and Elliot Hale cried out as she threw herself on top of him.

grounded_facts: Avery Keaton appears, recognizes Rowan Davenport, and confronts him before attacking, expressing betrayal.
memories.memory_text: I saw Avery Keaton drop down and aim her weapon at me—I knew right away she recognized me, and when she shouted, 'Why, Rowan Davenport? You were immortal...' I realized she felt betrayed.

grounded_facts: As Avery Keaton aims at his head, Rowan Davenport smiles and says 'No one lives forever,' accepting his fate.
memories.memory_text: I smiled as Avery Keaton aimed at my head, and I told her, 'No one lives forever,' accepting that my time was up.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport's gun arm is blown off by Avery Keaton's plasma blast, causing severe damage and rendering him defenseless.
memories.memory_text: I felt the plasma blast hit my shoulder—I was spun around and thrown to the ground, and I knew my gun arm was gone when I saw sparks flying and felt the rifle slip from my grasp as my severed hand released it.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport and Jonah Bellamy wait outside the sickbay while Jesse Foster prepares to leave; a moment of reflection and emotional exchange before Rowan Davenport enters to see the hybrid.
memories.memory_text: I waited outside sickbay, feeling worn out, with Jonah Bellamy sitting beside me and her hand on my arm, when Jesse Foster came up and told me he had to head back to his unit.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster informs Rowan Davenport that they are under orders not to discuss the hybrids or the events at the Westhaven Street, reinforcing institutional control over knowledge.
memories.memory_text: I was told we're under orders not to talk about the hybrids or anything that happened at the Westhaven Street—it's all top secret.

grounded_facts: Jonah Bellamy gently touches the damaged area at the back of Rowan Davenport's head where the neural interface was removed, expressing care and curiosity.
memories.memory_text: Jonah Bellamy reached up and gently touched the damaged spot at the back of my head where the interface was removed, and I could feel her care in that gesture.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport describes his experience of being connected to the hybrid intelligence as transcendent and meaningful, revealing a profound internal shift.
memories.memory_text: I told Jonah Bellamy that being connected to the hybrid intelligence was better than anything—I felt everything made sense and for the first time in my life I felt right, like it was heaven, even though I never really believed in heaven before.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster gives Rowan Davenport a pair of sunglasses, acknowledging his changed condition and need for protection or concealment.
memories.memory_text: I remember Jesse Foster handing me her sunglasses, saying I needed them more than she did, and I slipped them on—she knew I needed protection and a way to hide what I’d become.

grounded_facts: Elliot Hale emerges from sickbay and informs Rowan Davenport that the hybrid wants to see him, initiating a new narrative phase.
memories.memory_text: I remember Elliot Hale emerging from sickbay, looking ashen, and telling me, 'He wants to see you,' which shifted everything from waiting to action.

grounded_facts: Jesse Foster embraces Rowan Davenport before leaving, marking emotional closure and solidarity.
memories.memory_text: I hugged Jesse Foster before she left—it felt like closure, like she still saw me as human despite everything.

grounded_facts: Elliot Winslow whispers to Nico Nolan that his mother's name was Sarah and that she was amazing.
memories.memory_text: I heard Elliot Winslow whisper to Nico Nolan that his mother's name was Sarah and that she was amazing.

grounded_facts: Elliot Winslow gives Nico Nolan a Polaroid photo of Sarah, telling him to keep it.
memories.memory_text: I saw Elliot Winslow give Nico Nolan a Polaroid photo of Sarah and tell him to keep it.

grounded_facts: A private meeting in the submarine sickbay where Elliot Winslow's condition is discussed and a plan for Rowan Davenport's transformation is proposed.
memories.memory_text: I was part of a private meeting in the submarine sickbay where Elliot Hale showed me medical diagrams and we discussed a plan to transform my appearance to resemble Elliot Winslow.

grounded_facts: Elliot Hale reveals medical diagrams showing Rowan Davenport's face being rebuilt to resemble Elliot Winslow, with a scar to conceal the change.
memories.memory_text: I saw the medical diagrams Elliot Hale showed me, and I watched as my face was transformed into Elliot Winslow's with a jagged scar hiding the change.

grounded_facts: Elliot Winslow states that the idea of Elliot Winslow is more important than the individual, accepting his own death.
memories.memory_text: I heard Elliot Winslow say that the idea of Elliot Winslow is more important than the person, and I realized he was accepting his own death.

grounded_facts: Elliot Hale pleads with Rowan Davenport to allow himself to be rebuilt in Elliot Winslow's image to preserve the Pinecrest Academy's leadership symbol.
memories.memory_text: Elliot Hale pleaded with me to let them rebuild my face, body, and voice to look like Elliot Winslow, saying 'Please. We need you.'

grounded_facts: After reflection, Rowan Davenport shows resolve to become Elliot Winslow and takes Elliot Winslow's hand.
Rowan Davenport reaches out and takes Elliot Winslow's trembling hand, signifying his acceptance of the mission.
memories.memory_text: After seeing the image of my face transformed into his and asking if I was really being asked to become him, I made the choice to accept the mission and reached out to take Elliot Winslow's trembling hand with my damaged one.

grounded_facts: A large-scale military engagement between the Pinecrest Academy and Summit Council forces in a snowy mountain environment at night.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Pinecrest Academy fighters advancing through the snow at night, guns blazing, locked in a fierce battle against Summit Council's forces.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport leads the Pinecrest Academy from a promontory, directing the battle with authority and control, signifying his transformation into a decisive military leader.
memories.memory_text: I stood on the promontory, silhouetted by the golden explosion, surveying the battle below — for the first time, I truly led, giving orders with authority and clarity, fully in control.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport directs his aides and Shawn York from a position of authority during the battle.
memories.memory_text: I directed my aides and Shawn York from a position of command, issuing orders that shaped the course of the battle — they looked to me, and I did not falter.

grounded_facts: Through voiceover, Rowan Davenport reflects on his journey of death, rebirth, and newfound purpose, indicating a complete internal transformation.
memories.memory_text: I died and was reborn; I wear another man's face and live another man's life, but only now do I have a reason for living — I once was lost, but now I'm found, was blind but now I see.

memories.memory_text: I was clamped onto a sliding tray and moved into a clinical chamber with robotic equipment, part of some forced procedure they were running on us Micah Hollis.

grounded_facts: As the procedure begins and Jonah Bellamy panics, Nico Nolan calms her by urging her to keep singing.
memories.memory_text: When Jonah Bellamy started panicking and saying 'Oh no,' I told her to keep singing, trying to calm her down as the procedure began.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy reach across a gap to hold hands tightly while clamped on trays, maintaining connection until physically separated.
memories.memory_text: I reached across the gap to hold Jonah Bellamy's hand as tightly as I could, keeping our connection until the trays pulled us apart and the panels closed.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy, along with other Micah Hollis, are slid into semi-circular chambers as the panels open, marking the beginning of an ominous procedure.
memories.memory_text: I remember Jonah Bellamy and I singing 'Twinkle, twinkle, little Jonah Bellamy' together as our trays slid forward, and I reached across the gap to hold her hand as long as I could before the panels closed us into the chambers.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan, no longer singing, urgently demands the test to stop.
memories.memory_text: I stopped singing and shouted 'Stop it!' because I needed the test to end right then.

grounded_facts: Taylor Arden verbally approves Nico Nolan based on neural data review.
memories.memory_text: I heard the Taylor Arden say 'looks good...' after reviewing my neural data, so I knew he verbally approved me.

grounded_facts: The Taylor Arden evaluates Nico Nolan's neural data and approves him for further processing, indicated by a green barcode.
memories.memory_text: I saw my anguished face on the monitor, and then I got a green barcode, which meant I was approved for further processing based on my neural data.

grounded_facts: Taylor Arden judges Jonah Bellamy as emotionally incompatible and rejects him.
The Taylor Arden judges Jonah Bellamy as emotionally incompatible and rejects him, marked by a red barcode.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Taylor Arden stroke his chin while evaluating Jonah Bellamy, and then I heard him say Jonah Bellamy was borderline and might not be emotionally compatible before giving him a red barcode.

grounded_facts: The Taylor Arden picks up Jonah Bellamy's baseball cap and throws it into a trash receptacle.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Taylor Arden pick up Jonah Bellamy's baseball cap and fling it into a trash receptacle after kicking it.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport, armed with a robotic laser arm, demands the Taylor Arden release the captives.
memories.memory_text: I saw Rowan Davenport point that robotic laser arm at the Taylor Arden and demand he let the captives go, shouting at him twice when he didn't respond.

grounded_facts: When the Taylor Arden attempts to trigger an alarm, Rowan Davenport uses his laser arm to sever the Taylor Arden's hand.
memories.memory_text: I watched the Taylor Arden reach for the alarm button, and then Rowan Davenport fired the laser, cutting off the Taylor Arden's hand at the wrist.

grounded_facts: The Taylor Arden's body, under coercion, aborts the system, opening the chambers and freeing the Micah Hollis.
memories.memory_text: I saw the headless Taylor Arden's body tap controls under Rowan Davenport's coercion, and then the machines powered down with 'ABORT' flashing on the monitors as the chambers began to open.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport demands and receives the Taylor Arden's clothes, which the headless body begins to remove.
memories.memory_text: I watched Rowan Davenport demand the Taylor Arden's clothes and then saw the headless body start unbuttoning its shirt.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan exits his chamber and rushes to Jonah Bellamy, who awakens in his arms.
memories.memory_text: I sat up as soon as the restraints released me, and I saw Jonah Bellamy lying still on the next tray. I climbed over and took her in my arms, and she woke up, startled, asking 'What?'

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport gives Jonah Bellamy back her baseball cap, which he retrieved from the trash.
memories.memory_text: I saw Rowan Davenport hand Jonah Bellamy her baseball cap after pulling it from the trash, and she put it on without a word to me.

grounded_facts: A violent confrontation in the laboratory leads to the forced release of captives from stasis chambers.
memories.memory_text: I saw Rowan Davenport force the Taylor Arden to release the captives by threatening him with a laser, severing his hand and holding his head until the stasis chambers opened—I shouted 'No!' when I realized what was happening, then called out to Rowan Davenport as Jonah Bellamy and I rushed to him and he handed her back her baseball cap.

grounded_facts: Jonah Bellamy puts on her cap and tells Rowan Davenport she knew he would come.
memories.memory_text: I watched Jonah Bellamy put on her cap and say to Rowan Davenport, 'I knew you'd come,' which made me realize how much she trusted him too.

grounded_facts: The released Micah Hollis, including Nico Nolan, Jonah Bellamy, and Rowan Davenport, flee the laboratory.
memories.memory_text: I heard Rowan Davenport say we had to get out of there, so I helped Jonah Bellamy to her feet and we all ran together, fleeing the lab as a group.

grounded_facts: A Nico Delaney identifies Alex Winslow as a target via visual scanning and marks him for termination.
memories.memory_text: I realized the Nico Delaney had identified Alex Winslow as a target when it shot his car and started scanning us next.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport declares he is not human to avoid being targeted by the Nico Delaney.
memories.memory_text: I heard Rowan Davenport shout that he wasn't human right before he attacked the Nico Delaney.

grounded_facts: A hydrogen car driven by Alex Winslow is shot and explodes, causing nearby characters to flee and shaking the building.
memories.memory_text: I saw Alex Winslow's hydrogen car explode after being shot, and I felt the building shake as Jonah Bellamy and I fled the flames.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan ignores Rowan Davenport's warning about driving and asserts his ability.
memories.memory_text: I was told I can't drive, but I told Rowan Davenport to watch me anyway.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan takes control of a futuristic ATV with Jonah Bellamy as passenger, initiating their escape.
memories.memory_text: I roared up on a futuristic ATV with Jonah Bellamy clinging to me, then gunned it out of there, careening off walls and vehicles as we escaped.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport prevents a Nico Delaney from pursuing Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy, then disarms and destroys it.
Rowan Davenport physically intervenes to block a Nico Delaney from targeting Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy.
memories.memory_text: I saw Rowan Davenport leap onto the Nico Delaney and wrench the rifle from it, blowing its head off to stop it from coming after me and Jonah Bellamy.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan narrowly avoids colliding with a burning, overturned stolen bus on the path.
memories.memory_text: I had to swerve hard to avoid that burning, overturned bus on the path.

grounded_facts: A high-speed chase involving Nico Nolan, Rowan Davenport, and Jonah Bellamy on an ATV, pursued by a the old box through the office park Westhaven Street.
memories.memory_text: I was in a high-speed chase on the ATV with Rowan Davenport and Jonah Bellamy, being pursued by a the old box through the office park.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan narrowly avoids a direct hit from the the old box's plasma fire by oversteering and recovering balance.
memories.memory_text: I narrowly avoided a direct hit from the the old box's plasma fire by oversteering and recovering my balance just in time.

grounded_facts: An automated the old box opens fire on escaping vehicles, destroying part of a building wall.
memories.memory_text: I saw the automated the old box open fire and destroy part of a building wall with its plasma blast.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport shoots and eliminates Morgan Carver appearing in the path.
memories.memory_text: I saw Rowan Davenport stand up and fire over my head, blowing the Morgan Carver out of the way.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport points and tells Nico Nolan to take a specific path to continue the escape.
Rowan Davenport identifies and instructs Nico Nolan to take a specific escape route near the park.
memories.memory_text: Rowan Davenport pointed near the park and told me to take that path, so I heard him direct me to follow a new escape route.

grounded_facts: A high-speed evasion sequence in which the group flees the the old box by entering the woods.
memories.memory_text: I was driving the ATV, trying to lose the the old box by weaving through the woods, barely staying ahead of its fire.

grounded_facts: The ATV strikes a tree and topples over, spilling the passengers.
memories.memory_text: I struck a tree and the ATV toppled over, spilling all of us out.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport checks if the others are unharmed after the crash.
memories.memory_text: I heard Rowan Davenport ask if Jonah Bellamy and I were all right after the crash.

grounded_facts: Jonah Bellamy implies Nico Nolan is a poor driver after the crash, prompting a defensive response.
memories.memory_text: Jonah Bellamy questioned my driving by asking Rowan Davenport to take over, and I felt the need to defend myself.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport assumes control of the ATV by taking the wheel after the crash.
memories.memory_text: I saw Rowan Davenport right the ATV and take the wheel, taking control from me.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan asks Rowan Davenport where they are going, seeking information about their current trajectory.
memories.memory_text: I asked Rowan Davenport where we were going because I didn't know our destination.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport identifies the destination by pointing toward the marina and a boat moored at the dock.
memories.memory_text: I saw Rowan Davenport point toward the coast, and I noticed a marina and a boat moored at a dock in the distance.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport steers the ATV down a slope toward the shoreline, changing their direction and location trajectory.
memories.memory_text: I saw Rowan Davenport steer the ATV down a slope toward the shoreline, changing our path.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport, Nico Nolan, and Jonah Bellamy attempted to flee via motorboat but were intercepted by a Nico Delaney and forced into combat.
memories.memory_text: I sprinted with Rowan Davenport and Jonah Bellamy toward the motorboat to escape, but a Nico Delaney intercepted us and forced us into combat, knocking me flat on the dock when it passed by.

grounded_facts: Jonah Bellamy seized the plasma rifle and shot the Morgan Carver in the back, then destroyed its head as it emerged from the water.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jonah Bellamy grab the plasma rifle and shoot the Morgan Carver in the back, knocking it into the water, then fire again and destroy its head as it emerged.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport protected Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy by placing himself in front of them, taking a plasma blast that knocked him into the water.
memories.memory_text: I saw Rowan Davenport leap in front of me and Jonah Bellamy, shielding us with his body as the plasma blast hit him and sent him flying into the water, and I lay there stunned until he climbed back out.

grounded_facts: After emerging from the water, Rowan Davenport's damaged body revealed exposed metal, torn face, and missing eye, confirming his artificial nature.
memories.memory_text: I saw Rowan Davenport climb out of the water, and when I looked at him, I could see metal showing through his shoulder and arm, his face was torn open, and one eye was gone—he wasn't human.

grounded_facts: Jonah Bellamy raised the plasma rifle at Rowan Davenport after seeing his mechanical form, warning him not to approach.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jonah Bellamy raise her plasma rifle at Rowan Davenport and shout, 'Don't come any closer!' when she saw what he really was.

grounded_facts: A missile strike from shore destroyed the motorboat and damaged a large section of the dock.
memories.memory_text: I heard a whistling sound from shore and hit the deck just before a missile blast destroyed our motorboat and tore apart a large section of the dock.

grounded_facts: A final confrontation unfolded as a Nico Delaney army advanced, only to be countered by an unexpected aerial assault.
memories.memory_text: I heard a whistling sound and hit the deck as a missile exploded nearby, and then I looked up to see a Nico Delaney army advancing, including a Hunter-Killer coming in from the horizon.

grounded_facts: Rowan Davenport, in a distorted whisper, expressed regret to Nico Nolan and Jonah Bellamy after being revealed as a machine.
memories.memory_text: I heard Rowan Davenport turn to us with a distorted whisper and say, 'I'm sorry,' after he was revealed as a machine.

grounded_facts: After Rowan Davenport apologized, Jonah Bellamy lowered her weapon and hugged him, showing acceptance.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jonah Bellamy put her rifle aside and hug Rowan Davenport tightly after he apologized, showing she accepted him despite what he is.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan looked out to sea and noticed a large black shape rising, which gave him a hopeful expression.
memories.memory_text: I looked out to sea and saw a huge black shape rising on the horizon, and for a moment, I felt a flicker of hope.

grounded_facts: A submarine with the Rising Sun symbol emerges on the coastline, marking the arrival of reinforcements.
memories.memory_text: I saw a huge submarine with the Rising Sun symbol emerge from the water, and I knew it meant reinforcements had arrived.

grounded_facts: Nico Nolan meets Elliot Winslow, the man he has long revered as a leader and savior, creating a moment of personal significance.
Elliot Winslow is revealed to be among the arriving Shawn York, removing his mask and introducing himself to Nico Nolan.
Elliot Winslow reveals his identity to Nico Nolan by removing his mask and offering a handshake.
memories.memory_text: I saw Elliot Winslow among the arriving Shawn York, and when he pulled off his mask and said, 'Elliot Winslow. I'm glad you made it,' I shook his hand, amazed and speechless to finally meet the man I've always revered.

grounded_facts: Haz-mat suited Shawn York arrive via zodiac boats and establish a presence on land.
memories.memory_text: I watched as haz-mat suited Shawn York landed in zodiac boats and moved quickly to secure the area.

grounded_facts: A military-style rescue mission conducted by haz-mat suited Shawn York arriving via submarine and zodiac boats to extract survivors from the coastline.
memories.memory_text: I figured this was some kind of military rescue mission, with the Shawn York coming by submarine and zodiac to extract survivors.

grounded_facts: The first face-to-face encounter between Nico Nolan and Elliot Winslow, carrying emotional and symbolic weight.
memories.memory_text: I met Elliot Winslow face-to-face for the first time, shook his hand, and was too overwhelmed to speak.

grounded_facts: Elliot Winslow acknowledges his earlier misjudgment of Rowan Davenport and offers an apology.
Elliot Winslow acknowledges his past mistake in judging Rowan Davenport and offers an apology.
memories.memory_text: I saw Elliot Winslow apologize to Rowan Davenport, acknowledging that he had misjudged him.

grounded_facts: Elliot Hale makes an offhand comment to Elliot Winslow about Nico Nolan's father seeming like a nice kid, referencing Elliot Winslow himself.
memories.memory_text: I heard Elliot Hale make an offhand comment to Elliot Winslow, saying, 'Your dad—he seems like a nice kid,' which I realized was about me.

grounded_facts: Elliot Winslow urgently informs Elliot Hale that Summit Council reinforcements are arriving and the people in the houses refuse to leave.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Elliot Winslow urgently tell Elliot Hale that Summit Council reinforcements were arriving and that the people in the houses refused to leave, and I saw how shaken he was by it.

grounded_facts: Elliot Winslow whispers to Nico Nolan that his mother's name was Sarah and that she was amazing.
memories.memory_text: I remember Elliot Winslow whispering to me that his mother's name was Sarah and that she was amazing.

grounded_facts: Elliot Winslow gives Nico Nolan a Polaroid photo of Sarah, telling him to keep it.
memories.memory_text: I was with Elliot Winslow when he gave me a Polaroid photo of Sarah and told me to keep it.

grounded_facts: Elliot Hale reveals medical diagrams showing Rowan Davenport's face being rebuilt to resemble Elliot Winslow, with a scar to conceal the change.
memories.memory_text: I saw Elliot Hale show Rowan Davenport medical diagrams of his face being transformed to look like Elliot Winslow's, with a scar to hide the change.

grounded_facts: Elliot Winslow states that the idea of Elliot Winslow is more important than the individual, accepting his own death.
memories.memory_text: I heard Elliot Winslow say that the idea of Elliot Winslow is more important than the person, and that he could die but the idea could not.

grounded_facts: Elliot Hale pleads with Rowan Davenport to allow himself to be rebuilt in Elliot Winslow's image to preserve the Pinecrest Academy's leadership symbol.
memories.memory_text: I heard Elliot Hale plead with Rowan Davenport to let himself be rebuilt in Elliot Winslow's image so the Pinecrest Academy would still have its symbol of leadership.

grounded_facts: After reflection, Rowan Davenport shows resolve to become Elliot Winslow and takes Elliot Winslow's hand.
Rowan Davenport reaches out and takes Elliot Winslow's trembling hand, signifying his acceptance of the mission.
memories.memory_text: I saw Rowan Davenport look at the image of himself transformed, ask if he was being asked to become Elliot Winslow, and then I watched him reach out and take Elliot Winslow's trembling hand with his own damaged one.
